column1: 这件不错，就买这件吧。
column2: Zhè jiàn búcuò, jiù mǎi zhè jiàn ba.
column3: This one's nice; let's buy this one.

column1: 今天去不去打球？
column2: Jīntiān qù bu qù dǎ qiú?
column3: Are we going to play ball today?

column1: 这两天有点儿累，不去打球了。
column2: Zhè liǎng tiān yǒudiǎnr lèi, bú qù dǎ qiú le.
column3: I've been a bit tired these days; I won't go play ball.

column1: 你在做什么呢？是在想昨天的考试吗？
column2: Nǐ zài zuò shénme ne? Shì zài xiǎng zuótiān de kǎoshì ma?
column3: What are you doing? Thinking about yesterday's exam?

column1: 是啊，我觉得听和说还可以，读和写不好，很多字我都不知道是什么意思。
column2: Shì a, wǒ juéde tīng hé shuō hái kěyǐ, dú hé xiě bù hǎo, hěn duō zì wǒ dōu bù zhīdào shì shénme yìsi.
column3: Yeah, I think my listening and speaking are okay, but reading and writing aren't good—I don't know what a lot of the characters mean.

column1: 休息一下吧，喝咖啡吗？
column2: Xiūxi yíxià ba, hē kāfēi ma?
column3: Take a break—want some coffee?

column1: 不喝了，我已经喝两杯了。
column2: Bù hē le, wǒ yǐjīng hē liǎng bēi le.
column3: No thanks, I've already had two cups.

column1: 是啊，咖啡喝多了对身体不好。
column2: Shì a, kāfēi hē duō le duì shēntǐ bù hǎo.
column3: Right, drinking too much coffee is bad for your health.

column1: 以后我少喝一点儿，每天喝一杯。
column2: Yǐhòu wǒ shǎo hē yìdiǎnr, měi tiān hē yì bēi.
column3: I'll drink less from now on—one cup a day.

column1: 你知道小王今天什么时候来学校吗？
column2: Nǐ zhīdào Xiǎo Wáng jīntiān shénme shíhou lái xuéxiào ma?
column3: Do you know when Xiao Wang is coming to school today?

column1: 他已经来了。
column2: Tā yǐjīng lái le.
column3: He's already here.

column1: 你怎么知道他来了？
column2: Nǐ zěnme zhīdào tā lái le?
column3: How do you know he's here?

column1: 我在门外看见他的自行车了。
column2: Wǒ zài mén wài kànjiàn tā de zìxíngchē le.
column3: I saw his bicycle outside the door.

column1: 今天的羊肉很好吃，你怎么不吃了？
column2: Jīntiān de yángròu hěn hǎochī, nǐ zěnme bù chī le?
column3: Today's lamb is delicious—why aren't you eating?

column1: 这个星期天天都吃羊肉，不想吃了。
column2: Zhège xīngqī tiāntiān dōu chī yángròu, bù xiǎng chī le.
column3: We've had lamb every day this week; I don't feel like it anymore.

column1: 那你还想吃什么？
column2: Nà nǐ hái xiǎng chī shénme?
column3: Then what else would you like to eat?

column1: 来一点儿面条吧。
column2: Lái yìdiǎnr miàntiáo ba.
column3: I'll have some noodles.

column1: 昨天你们怎么都没去打篮球？
column2: Zuótiān nǐmen zěnme dōu méi qù dǎ lánqiú?
column3: Why didn't any of you go play basketball yesterday?

column1: 因为昨天下雨，所以我们都没去。我去游泳了。
column2: Yīnwèi zuótiān xià yǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen dōu méi qù. Wǒ qù yóuyǒng le.
column3: Because it rained yesterday, none of us went. I went swimming.

column1: 你经常游泳吗？
column2: Nǐ jīngcháng yóuyǒng ma?
column3: Do you swim often?

column1: 这个月我天天游泳，我现在七十公斤了。
column2: Zhège yuè wǒ tiāntiān yóuyǒng, wǒ xiànzài qīshí gōngjīn le.
column3: I've been swimming every day this month; I'm seventy kilos now.

column1: 这两天怎么没看见小张？
column2: Zhè liǎng tiān zěnme méi kànjiàn Xiǎo Zhāng?
column3: Why haven't I seen Xiao Zhang these last couple of days?

column1: 他去北京了。
column2: Tā qù Běijīng le.
column3: He went to Beijing.

column1: 去北京了？是去旅游吗？
column2: Qù Běijīng le? Shì qù lǚyóu ma?
column3: Went to Beijing? To travel?

column1: 不是，听说是去看他姐姐。
column2: Bú shì, tīngshuō shì qù kàn tā jiějie.
column3: No, I heard he went to visit his sister.

column1: 大卫回来了吗？
column2: Dàwèi huílai le ma?
column3: Is David back?

column1: 没有，他还在教室学习呢。
column2: Méiyǒu, tā hái zài jiàoshì xuéxí ne.
column3: No, he's still studying in the classroom.

column1: 已经九点多了，他怎么还在学习？
column2: Yǐjīng jiǔ diǎn duō le, tā zěnme hái zài xuéxí?
column3: It's already past nine—why is he still studying?

column1: 明天有考试，他说今天要好好准备。
column2: Míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì, tā shuō jīntiān yào hǎohǎo zhǔnbèi.
column3: There's an exam tomorrow; he says he wants to prepare well today.

column1: 你现在在哪儿呢？
column2: Nǐ xiànzài zài nǎr ne?
column3: Where are you right now?

column1: 在去机场的路上。你已经到了？
column2: Zài qù jīchǎng de lù shàng. Nǐ yǐjīng dào le?
column3: On the way to the airport. Are you there already?

column1: 我下飞机了。你还有多长时间能到这儿？
column2: Wǒ xià fēijī le. Nǐ hái yǒu duō cháng shíjiān néng dào zhèr?
column3: I've gotten off the plane. How much longer until you get here?

column1: 二十分钟就到。
column2: Èrshí fēnzhōng jiù dào.
column3: I'll be there in twenty minutes.

column1: 你家离公司远吗？
column2: Nǐ jiā lí gōngsī yuǎn ma?
column3: Is your home far from the office?

column1: 很远，坐公共汽车要一个多小时呢！
column2: Hěn yuǎn, zuò gōnggòng qìchē yào yí ge duō xiǎoshí ne!
column3: Very far—it takes over an hour by bus!

column1: 坐公共汽车太慢了，你怎么不开车？
column2: Zuò gōnggòng qìchē tài màn le, nǐ zěnme bù kāichē?
column3: The bus is too slow—why don't you drive?

column1: 开车也不快，路上车太多了！
column2: Kāichē yě bú kuài, lù shàng chē tài duō le!
column3: Driving isn't fast either—there are too many cars on the road!

column1: 今天晚上我们一起吃饭吧，给你过生日。
column2: Jīntiān wǎnshang wǒmen yìqǐ chī fàn ba, gěi nǐ guò shēngrì.
column3: Let's have dinner together tonight to celebrate your birthday.

column1: 今天？离我的生日还有一个多星期呢！
column2: Jīntiān? Lí wǒ de shēngrì hái yǒu yí ge duō xīngqī ne!
column3: Today? My birthday is still over a week away!

column1: 下个星期我要去北京，今天过吧。
column2: Xià ge xīngqī wǒ yào qù Běijīng, jīntiān guò ba.
column3: I'm going to Beijing next week, so let's celebrate today.

column1: 好吧，离这儿不远有一个中国饭馆，走几分钟就到了。
column2: Hǎo ba, lí zhèr bù yuǎn yǒu yí ge Zhōngguó fànguǎn, zǒu jǐ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
column3: All right, there's a Chinese restaurant not far from here—just a few minutes' walk.

column1: 我们下午去看电影，好吗？
column2: Wǒmen xiàwǔ qù kàn diànyǐng, hǎo ma?
column3: Shall we go see a movie this afternoon?

column1: 今天下午我没有时间，明天下午再去吧。
column2: Jīntiān xiàwǔ wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān, míngtiān xiàwǔ zài qù ba.
column3: I don't have time this afternoon; let's go tomorrow afternoon instead.

column1: 你想看什么电影？
column2: Nǐ xiǎng kàn shénme diànyǐng?
column3: What movie do you want to see?

column1: 让我想想再告诉你。
column2: Ràng wǒ xiǎngxiang zài gàosu nǐ.
column3: Let me think about it and tell you.

column1: 外边天气很好，我们出去运动运动吧。
column2: Wàibian tiānqì hěn hǎo, wǒmen chūqu yùndòng yùndòng ba.
column3: The weather's nice outside; let's go out and get some exercise.

column1: 你等等我，好吗？王老师让我给大卫打个电话。
column2: Nǐ děngdeng wǒ, hǎo ma? Wáng lǎoshī ràng wǒ gěi Dàwèi dǎ ge diànhuà.
column3: Wait for me, okay? Teacher Wang asked me to give David a call.

column1: 回来再打吧。找大卫有什么事情吗？
column2: Huílai zài dǎ ba. Zhǎo Dàwèi yǒu shénme shìqing ma?
column3: Call when you get back. What do you need David for?

column1: 听说大卫病了，我想找时间去看看他。
column2: Tīngshuō Dàwèi bìng le, wǒ xiǎng zhǎo shíjiān qù kànkan tā.
column3: I heard David is sick; I want to find time to go visit him.

column1: 服务员，我房间的门打不开了。
column2: Fúwùyuán, wǒ fángjiān de mén dǎ bu kāi le.
column3: Excuse me, I can't get my room door open.

column1: 您住哪个房间？
column2: Nín zhù nǎge fángjiān?
column3: Which room are you staying in?

column2: Sān yāo qī.
column3: Room 317.

column1: 好的，我叫人去看看。
column2: Hǎo de, wǒ jiào rén qù kànkan.
column3: Okay, I'll send someone to check.

column1: 你看看这几件衣服怎么样。
column2: Nǐ kànkan zhè jǐ jiàn yīfu zěnmeyàng.
column3: Take a look at these clothes and see what you think.

column1: 这件白的有点儿长，那件黑的有点儿贵。
column2: Zhè jiàn bái de yǒudiǎnr cháng, nà jiàn hēi de yǒudiǎnr guì.
column3: The white one is a bit long, and the black one is a bit expensive.

column1: 这件红的呢？这是今天新来的。
column2: Zhè jiàn hóng de ne? Zhè shì jīntiān xīn lái de.
column3: How about this red one? It just came in today.

column1: 让我再看看。
column2: Ràng wǒ zài kànkan.
column3: Let me have another look.

column1: 你好！请问张欢在吗？
column2: Nǐ hǎo! Qǐngwèn Zhāng Huān zài ma?
column3: Hello! Is Zhang Huan there?

column1: 你打错了，我们这儿没有叫张欢的。
column2: Nǐ dǎ cuò le, wǒmen zhèr méiyǒu jiào Zhāng Huān de.
column3: You've got the wrong number; there's no one named Zhang Huan here.

column1: 对不起。
column2: Duìbuqǐ.
column3: Sorry.

column1: 您从几岁开始学习跳舞？
column2: Nín cóng jǐ suì kāishǐ xuéxí tiàowǔ?
column3: At what age did you start learning to dance?

column1: 我第一次跳舞是在七岁的时候。
column2: Wǒ dì-yī cì tiàowǔ shì zài qī suì de shíhou.
column3: I danced for the first time when I was seven.

column1: 我女儿今年也七岁了。我希望她能跟您学跳舞，可以吗？
column2: Wǒ nǚ'ér jīnnián yě qī suì le. Wǒ xīwàng tā néng gēn nín xué tiàowǔ, kěyǐ ma?
column3: My daughter is also seven this year. I hope she can learn to dance with you—would that be okay?

column1: 没问题，非常欢迎。
column2: Méi wèntí, fēicháng huānyíng.
column3: No problem, she's very welcome.

column1: 你知道吗？大卫找到工作了。
column2: Nǐ zhīdào ma? Dàwèi zhǎodào gōngzuò le.
column3: Did you know? David found a job.

column1: 太好了！他从什么时候开始上班？
column2: Tài hǎo le! Tā cóng shénme shíhou kāishǐ shàngbān?
column3: Great! When does he start work?

column1: 从下个星期一开始。
column2: Cóng xià ge xīngqīyī kāishǐ.
column3: Starting next Monday.

column1: 这是他的第一个工作，希望他能喜欢。
column2: Zhè shì tā de dì-yī ge gōngzuò, xīwàng tā néng xǐhuan.
column3: It's his first job; I hope he'll like it.

column1: 昨天的考试怎么样？你都听懂了吗？
column2: Zuótiān de kǎoshì zěnmeyàng? Nǐ dōu tīngdǒng le ma?
column3: How was yesterday's exam? Did you understand it all?

column1: 听懂了。
column2: Tīngdǒng le.
column3: Yes, I understood.

column1: 你都做完了没有？
column2: Nǐ dōu zuòwán le méiyǒu?
column3: Did you finish it all?

column1: 题太多，我没做完。
column2: Tí tài duō, wǒ méi zuòwán.
column3: There were too many questions; I didn't finish.

column1: 不要看电视了，明天上午还有汉语课呢。
column2: Bú yào kàn diànshì le, míngtiān shàngwǔ hái yǒu Hànyǔ kè ne.
column3: Stop watching TV—you have Chinese class tomorrow morning.

column1: 看电视对学汉语有帮助。
column2: Kàn diànshì duì xué Hànyǔ yǒu bāngzhù.
column3: Watching TV helps with learning Chinese.

column1: 明天的课你都准备好了吗？
column2: Míngtiān de kè nǐ dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?
column3: Have you prepared everything for tomorrow's class?

column1: 都准备好了。
column2: Dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
column3: Yes, all prepared.

column1: 别看报纸了，医生说你要多休息。
column2: Bié kàn bàozhǐ le, yīshēng shuō nǐ yào duō xiūxi.
column3: Stop reading the newspaper—the doctor says you need more rest.

column2: Hǎo, bú kàn le. Gěi wǒ yì bēi chá ba.
column3: Okay, I'll stop. Get me a cup of tea, please.

column1: 医生说吃药后两个小时不要喝茶。
column2: Yīshēng shuō chī yào hòu liǎng ge xiǎoshí bú yào hē chá.
column3: The doctor said not to drink tea for two hours after taking medicine.

column1: 医生还说什么了？
column2: Yīshēng hái shuō shénme le?
column3: What else did the doctor say?

column1: 医生让你听我的。
column2: Yīshēng ràng nǐ tīng wǒ de.
column3: The doctor said you should listen to me.

column1: 你怎么买了这么多东西啊？
column2: Nǐ zěnme mǎi le zhème duō dōngxi a?
column3: Why did you buy so much stuff?

column1: 哥哥今天中午回来吃饭。
column2: Gēge jīntiān zhōngwǔ huílai chī fàn.
column3: My older brother is coming home for lunch today.

column1: 我看看买什么了。羊肉、鸡蛋、面条、西瓜……真不少！妈妈呢？
column2: Wǒ kànkan mǎi shénme le. Yángròu, jīdàn, miàntiáo, xīguā…… zhēn bù shǎo! Māma ne?
column3: Let me see what you bought. Lamb, eggs, noodles, watermelon… that's a lot! Where's Mom?

column1: 正在准备午饭呢！
column2: Zhèngzài zhǔnbèi wǔfàn ne!
column3: She's making lunch!

column1: 你在找什么？
column2: Nǐ zài zhǎo shénme?
column3: What are you looking for?

column1: 你看见我的手机了吗？白色的。
column2: Nǐ kànjiàn wǒ de shǒujī le ma? Báisè de.
column3: Have you seen my phone? The white one.

column1: 别找了，手机在桌子上呢，电脑旁边。
column2: Bié zhǎo le, shǒujī zài zhuōzi shàng ne, diànnǎo pángbiān.
column3: Stop looking—the phone's on the table, next to the computer.

column1: 你看见我的衣服了吗？红色的那件。
column2: Nǐ kànjiàn wǒ de yīfu le ma? Hóngsè de nà jiàn.
column3: Have you seen my clothes? The red one.

column1: 那件衣服我帮你洗了，在外边呢。
column2: Nà jiàn yīfu wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ le, zài wàibian ne.
column3: I washed that one for you; it's outside.

column1: 王方，昨天和你一起唱歌的人是谁？
column2: Wáng Fāng, zuótiān hé nǐ yìqǐ chànggē de rén shì shéi?
column3: Wang Fang, who was that person singing with you yesterday?

column1: 一个朋友。
column2: Yí ge péngyou.
column3: A friend.

column1: 什么朋友？是不是男朋友？
column2: Shénme péngyou? Shì bu shì nánpéngyou?
column3: What kind of friend? Is he your boyfriend?

column1: 不是不是，我同学介绍的，昨天第一次见。
column2: Bú shì bú shì, wǒ tóngxué jièshào de, zuótiān dì-yī cì jiàn.
column3: No, no—a classmate introduced us; yesterday was the first time we met.

column1: 左边这个看报纸的女孩子是你姐姐吗？
column2: Zuǒbian zhège kàn bàozhǐ de nǚ háizi shì nǐ jiějie ma?
column3: Is the girl on the left reading the newspaper your sister?

column1: 是，右边写字的那个人是我哥哥。
column2: Shì, yòubian xiě zì de nàge rén shì wǒ gēge.
column3: Yes, and the person writing on the right is my older brother.

column1: 你哥哥多大？
column2: Nǐ gēge duō dà?
column3: How old is your brother?

column1: 25岁，他比我大三岁。
column2: Èrshíwǔ suì, tā bǐ wǒ dà sān suì.
column3: Twenty-five; he's three years older than me.

column1: 今天的西瓜怎么卖？
column2: Jīntiān de xīguā zěnme mài?
column3: How much is the watermelon today?

column1: 三块五一斤。
column2: Sān kuài wǔ yì jīn.
column3: Three-fifty a jin.

column1: 比昨天便宜。
column2: Bǐ zuótiān piányi.
column3: Cheaper than yesterday.

column1: 是，苹果也比昨天便宜一些。您来点儿吧。
column2: Shì, píngguǒ yě bǐ zuótiān piányi yìxiē. Nín lái diǎnr ba.
column3: Yes, the apples are a bit cheaper than yesterday too. Have some.

column1: 前边说话的那个人就是我的汉语老师。你可能不认识她。
column2: Qiánbian shuōhuà de nàge rén jiù shì wǒ de Hànyǔ lǎoshī. Nǐ kěnéng bú rènshi tā.
column3: The person talking up front is my Chinese teacher. You probably don't know her.

column1: 是新来的汉语老师吗？
column2: Shì xīn lái de Hànyǔ lǎoshī ma?
column3: Is she the new Chinese teacher?

column1: 是去年来的，她姓王，28岁。
column2: Shì qùnián lái de, tā xìng Wáng, èrshíbā suì.
column3: She came last year; her surname is Wang, and she's twenty-eight.

column1: 她比我们老师小两岁。
column2: Tā bǐ wǒmen lǎoshī xiǎo liǎng suì.
column3: She's two years younger than our teacher.

column1: 你每天早上几点起床？
column2: Nǐ měi tiān zǎoshang jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng?
column3: What time do you get up every morning?

column1: 六点多。
column2: Liù diǎn duō.
column3: A little after six.

column1: 你比我早起一个小时。
column2: Nǐ bǐ wǒ zǎo qǐ yí ge xiǎoshí.
column3: You get up an hour earlier than me.

column1: 我睡得也早，我每天晚上十点就睡觉。早睡早起身体好。
column2: Wǒ shuì de yě zǎo, wǒ měi tiān wǎnshang shí diǎn jiù shuìjiào. Zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ shēntǐ hǎo.
column3: I go to bed early too—I sleep at ten every night. Early to bed and early to rise is good for your health.

column1: 再来点儿米饭吧，你吃得太少了。
column2: Zài lái diǎnr mǐfàn ba, nǐ chī de tài shǎo le.
column3: Have some more rice—you've eaten too little.

column1: 不少了，今天吃得很好，太谢谢你了。

column1: 听说你下个星期就要回国了？

column3: I heard you're going back to your country next week?

column3: Yeah, I really don't want to leave Beijing.

column3: This little panda is for you—you're welcome to come back to China anytime.

column1: 小刚，我们坐哪儿？

column3: Wherever you sit, I'll sit.

column3: Let's sit here—it's quiet. What would you like to drink?

column1: 你喝什么我就喝什么。
column2: Nǐ hē shénme wǒ jiù hē shénme.
column3: Whatever you drink, I'll drink.

column2: Hē kělè ba. Nǐ děng wǒ yíhuìr, wǒ mǎshàng huílai.
column3: Let's have cola. Wait a moment—I'll be right back.

column2: Jiànkāng zuì zhòngyào, pàng shòu méi guānxi.
column3: Health matters most; fat or thin doesn't matter.

column1: 是呀，想吃什么就吃什么。
column2: Shì ya, xiǎng chī shénme jiù chī shénme.
column3: Right—eat whatever you want.

column3: Do you cook, or does Zhou Ming?

column2: Wǒ zuò, wǒ xiǎng chī shénme jiù zuò shénme, xiǎng chī duōshao jiù zuò duōshao.
column3: I do—I make whatever I want to eat, and as much as I want.

column1: 马可，你的中文越说越好了！
column2: Mǎkě, nǐ de Zhōngwén yuè shuō yuè hǎo le!
column3: Marco, your Chinese gets better the more you speak it!

column1: 哪里哪里，我们班李静说得更好。
column2: Nǎli nǎli, wǒmen bān Lǐ Jìng shuō de gèng hǎo.
column3: You're too kind—Li Jing in our class speaks even better.

column1: 怎么好？

column3: She speaks Chinese as well as a native.

column1: 李静？我怎么没听说过这个名字？

column2: Tā shì wǒmen de Hànyǔ lǎoshī.
column3: She's our Chinese teacher.

column1: 别吃了，你已经吃了三块蛋糕了。

column3: Stop eating—you've already had three slices of cake.

column1: 这是最后一块。
column2: Zhè shì zuìhòu yí kuài.
column3: This is the last slice.

column1: 你总是吃甜的东西，会越吃越胖。
column2: Nǐ zǒngshì chī tián de dōngxi, huì yuè chī yuè pàng.
column3: You always eat sweets—you'll get fatter the more you eat.

column2: Nǐ fàngxīn, wǒ yídìng bú huì biàn pàng.
column3: Don't worry, I definitely won't get fat.

column1: 我们家的人都很瘦，吃不胖。
column2: Wǒmen jiā de rén dōu hěn shòu, chī bu pàng.
column3: Everyone in my family is thin—we can't gain weight.

column1: 我有点儿害怕。
column2: Wǒ yǒudiǎnr hàipà.
column3: I'm a little scared.

column1: 山越高，路越难走。我也越爬越冷。
column2: Shān yuè gāo, lù yuè nán zǒu. Wǒ yě yuè pá yuè lěng.
column3: The higher the mountain, the harder the path. I'm also getting colder the more I climb.

column1: 不用担心，有我呢，我对这儿比较了解。
column2: Bú yòng dānxīn, yǒu wǒ ne, wǒ duì zhèr bǐjiào liǎojiě.
column3: Don't worry, I'm here—I know this place fairly well.

column1: 那我们先休息一下，一会儿再爬。
column2: Nà wǒmen xiān xiūxi yíxià, yíhuìr zài pá.
column3: Then let's rest first and climb again in a bit.

column1: 好，一会儿我们可以从中间这条路上去。
column2: Hǎo, yíhuìr wǒmen kěyǐ cóng zhōngjiān zhè tiáo lù shàngqu.
column3: Okay, in a bit we can go up via this middle path.

column1: 小明，你的眼睛怎么跟大熊猫一样了？
column2: Xiǎo Míng, nǐ de yǎnjing zěnme gēn dà xióngmāo yíyàng le?
column3: Xiao Ming, why do your eyes look like a panda's?

column1: 我这几天脚疼，没休息好。
column2: Wǒ zhè jǐ tiān jiǎo téng, méi xiūxi hǎo.
column3: My feet have hurt these past few days, and I haven't rested well.

column1: 去医院了吗？医生说什么？
column2: Qù yīyuàn le ma? Yīshēng shuō shénme?
column3: Did you go to the hospital? What did the doctor say?

column1: 他让我多休息。休息得越多，好得越快。
column2: Tā ràng wǒ duō xiūxi. Xiūxi de yuè duō, hǎo de yuè kuài.
column3: He told me to rest more. The more I rest, the faster I'll recover.

column3: Can you take part in next month's basketball game?

column1: 我喜欢历史课、体育课，不喜欢数学课。

column3: I think math is much harder than history—I can't follow it.

column1: 别担心，我可以帮你。
column2: Bié dānxīn, wǒ kěyǐ bāng nǐ.
column3: Don't worry, I can help you.

column1: 好啊，我们每天学多长时间？
column2: Hǎo a, wǒmen měi tiān xué duō cháng shíjiān?
column3: Great—how long should we study each day?

column2: Yī-liǎng ge xiǎoshí ba.
column3: An hour or two.

column3: You've been arriving much earlier than before—did you move?

column3: Yeah, didn't you know? I moved last month—it's just a twenty-minute walk now.

column1: 这个笔记本电脑我去年买的时候要五千块左右，现在便宜多了。我想把这个电脑卖了，再买一个更好的。现在我每天起床后的第一件事就是打开电脑，看电子邮件。我已经很少写信，也很少用笔写字，已经习惯用电脑来学习和工作了。哪一天突然没有了电脑，我们怎么办呢？
column2: Zhège bǐjìběn diànnǎo wǒ qùnián mǎi de shíhou yào wǔqiān kuài zuǒyòu, xiànzài piányi duō le. Wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhège diànnǎo mài le, zài mǎi yí ge gèng hǎo de. Xiànzài wǒ měi tiān qǐchuáng hòu de dì-yī jiàn shì jiù shì dǎkāi diànnǎo, kàn diànzǐ yóujiàn. Wǒ yǐjīng hěn shǎo xiě xìn, yě hěn shǎo yòng bǐ xiě zì, yǐjīng xíguàn yòng diànnǎo lái xuéxí hé gōngzuò le. Nǎ yì tiān tūrán méiyǒu le diànnǎo, wǒmen zěnme bàn ne?
column3: When I bought this laptop last year it cost around five thousand yuan; now it's much cheaper. I want to sell it and buy a better one. These days the first thing I do after getting up is open the computer and check my email. I rarely write letters or write by hand anymore—I've gotten used to studying and working on the computer. If one day the computer were suddenly gone, what would we do?

column1: 今天太阳从西边出来了吗？

column3: Did the sun rise in the west today?

column3: Why are you only getting here now?

column1: “运动很重要”这句话谁都懂。但是你知道怎么运动吗？第一，要选择“对”的时间。一般来说，早上9点是最好的时间，冬天要再晚一些。第二，要选择“对”的地点，公园、山上、游泳馆，这些地方都可以运动。第三，必须要根据自己的健康情况运动。如果你很久没爬山或者游泳了，运动一会儿就一定要休息休息。还要记得刚运动完口渴的时候，不要马上喝水。

column3: Everyone understands the phrase "exercise is important." But do you know how to exercise? First, choose the "right" time. Generally, 9 a.m. is best, a bit later in winter. Second, choose the "right" place—parks, hills, swimming pools are all fine. Third, you must exercise according to your own health. If you haven't hiked or swum in a long time, be sure to rest after a little exercise. Also remember not to drink water right away when you're thirsty just after exercising.

column3: My boyfriend likes watching soccer, and he got me into it.

column1: 看来只有爱，才能让人有变化。
column2: Kànlái zhǐyǒu ài, cái néng ràng rén yǒu biànhuà.
column3: It seems only love can change a person.

column1: 是啊，为了和他的爱好一样，我天天看球赛。
column2: Shì a, wèile hé tā de àihào yíyàng, wǒ tiāntiān kàn qiúsài.
column3: Yeah—to share his hobby, I watch matches every day.

column1: 除了足球，他还影响你什么了？
column2: Chúle zúqiú, tā hái yǐngxiǎng nǐ shénme le?
column3: Besides soccer, what else has he influenced you on?

column1: 我最近天天上网玩儿游戏，我的成绩差极了。
column2: Wǒ zuìjìn tiāntiān shàngwǎng wánr yóuxì, wǒ de chéngjì chà jí le.
column3: Lately I play games online every day, and my grades are terrible.

column1: 那个拿着碗吃饭的人是你哥哥吗？他和你长得真像。
column2: Nàge názhe wǎn chī fàn de rén shì nǐ gēge ma? Tā hé nǐ zhǎng de zhēn xiàng.
column3: Is the one holding a bowl and eating your older brother? He looks just like you.

column1: 我们经常被别人认错。
column2: Wǒmen jīngcháng bèi biéren rèncuò.
column3: People often mistake us for each other.

column1: 只有你们的爸爸妈妈才能分出来哪个是哥哥，哪个是弟弟吧。
column2: Zhǐyǒu nǐmen de bàba māma cái néng fēn chūlai nǎge shì gēge, nǎge shì dìdi ba.
column3: Only your mom and dad can tell which is the older brother and which is the younger, I bet.

column1: 除了父母以外，还有我们自己也能啊。
column2: Chúle fùmǔ yǐwài, hái yǒu wǒmen zìjǐ yě néng a.
column3: Besides our parents, we ourselves can too.

column1: 你们两个除了长得像，还有什么相同的地方？
column2: Nǐmen liǎng ge chúle zhǎng de xiàng, hái yǒu shénme xiāngtóng de dìfang?
column3: Besides looking alike, what else do you two have in common?

column1: 我们住在同一个楼、同一个房间……
column2: Wǒmen zhù zài tóng yí ge lóu, tóng yí ge fángjiān……
column3: We live in the same building, in the same room…

column1: 年轻人遇到难题，常常很着急，不知道怎么办。其实，不同的问题有不同的解决办法。有些问题看上去很难，但是做起来非常简单，所以得试着做做。有些问题看上去虽然简单，但是解决起来难极了。所以只有真正做事情的时候，才能了解有多难。不过，我们一定要相信：多么难的问题，都会被解决的。
column2: Niánqīng rén yùdào nántí, chángcháng hěn zháojí, bù zhīdào zěnme bàn. Qíshí, bùtóng de wèntí yǒu bùtóng de jiějué bànfǎ. Yǒuxiē wèntí kàn shàngqu hěn nán, dànshì zuò qǐlai fēicháng jiǎndān, suǒyǐ děi shìzhe zuòzuo. Yǒuxiē wèntí kàn shàngqu suīrán jiǎndān, dànshì jiějué qǐlai nán jí le. Suǒyǐ zhǐyǒu zhēnzhèng zuò shìqing de shíhou, cái néng liǎojiě yǒu duō nán. Búguò, wǒmen yídìng yào xiāngxìn: duōme nán de wèntí, dōu huì bèi jiějué de.
column3: When young people run into tough problems, they often get anxious and don't know what to do. Actually, different problems have different solutions. Some problems look hard but are very simple to do, so you have to try. Some look simple but are extremely hard to solve. So only when you actually do something can you understand how hard it is. Still, we must believe: no matter how hard a problem is, it can be solved.

column1: # --- 新版 HSK2 (newhsk3-2) ---
请问，您是王一飞老师的姐姐吗？
column2: Qǐngwèn, nín shì Wáng Yīfēi lǎoshī de jiějie ma?
column3: Excuse me, are you Teacher Wang Yifei's sister?

column1: 是的，你们就是她的学生吧？
column2: Shì de, nǐmen jiù shì tā de xuésheng ba?
column3: Yes—you must be her students?

column1: 对。我是白家月，她是安妮。
column2: Duì. Wǒ shì Bái Jiāyuè, tā shì Ānnī.
column3: Right. I'm Bai Jiayue, and she's Annie.

column1: 你们好，我叫王一雪。一飞给我打电话了，让我来接你们。
column2: Nǐmen hǎo, wǒ jiào Wáng Yīxuě. Yīfēi gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà le, ràng wǒ lái jiē nǐmen.
column3: Hello, I'm Wang Yixue. Yifei called me and asked me to come pick you up.

column1: 谢谢您。
column2: Xièxie nín.
column3: Thank you.

column1: 你们是第一次来北京吗？
column2: Nǐmen shì dì-yī cì lái Běijīng ma?
column3: Is this your first time in Beijing?

column1: 是的，我们都是第一次来。
column2: Shì de, wǒmen dōu shì dì-yī cì lái.
column3: Yes, it's the first time for both of us.

column1: 你们是来学中文的吗？
column2: Nǐmen shì lái xué Zhōngwén de ma?
column3: Are you here to study Chinese?

column1: 不是，我们是来旅游的。
column2: Bú shì, wǒmen shì lái lǚyóu de.
column3: No, we're here to travel.

column1: 我这几天都不忙，你们有事就找我。
column2: Wǒ zhè jǐ tiān dōu bù máng, nǐmen yǒu shì jiù zhǎo wǒ.
column3: I'm free these days—come to me if you need anything.

column1: 好的，谢谢您。
column2: Hǎo de, xièxie nín.
column3: Okay, thank you.

column1: 喂，家月，你明天有时间吗？我想请你帮个忙。
column2: Wéi, Jiāyuè, nǐ míngtiān yǒu shíjiān ma? Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ bāng ge máng.
column3: Hello, Jiayue, do you have time tomorrow? I'd like to ask you for a favor.

column1: 不好意思，天中，我已经到北京了。
column2: Bù hǎoyìsi, Tiānzhōng, wǒ yǐjīng dào Běijīng le.
column3: Sorry, Tianzhong, I've already arrived in Beijing.

column1: 你是什么时候到的？
column2: Nǐ shì shénme shíhou dào de?
column3: When did you get there?

column1: 我是今天早上到的。你有事可以叫李文帮忙，他还在学校呢。
column2: Wǒ shì jīntiān zǎoshang dào de. Nǐ yǒu shì kěyǐ jiào Lǐ Wén bāngmáng, tā hái zài xuéxiào ne.
column3: I got here this morning. If you need help, you can ask Li Wen—he's still at school.

column1: 好的，那我给他打个电话。
column2: Hǎo de, nà wǒ gěi tā dǎ ge diànhuà.
column3: Okay, then I'll give him a call.

column1: 好，再见！
column2: Hǎo, zàijiàn!
column3: Okay, bye!

column1: 王老师，我们已经到北京了，是您姐姐来接的我们。她请我们吃了北京烤鸭，还给我们介绍了很多东西。我们的中文不太好，有时不太懂她的意思。
column2: Wáng lǎoshī, wǒmen yǐjīng dào Běijīng le, shì nín jiějie lái jiē de wǒmen. Tā qǐng wǒmen chī le Běijīng kǎoyā, hái gěi wǒmen jièshào le hěn duō dōngxi. Wǒmen de Zhōngwén bú tài hǎo, yǒushí bú tài dǒng tā de yìsi.
column3: Teacher Wang, we've arrived in Beijing—your sister came to pick us up. She treated us to Peking duck and told us about many things. Our Chinese isn't very good, so sometimes we don't quite understand what she means.

column1: 请问，这儿有到北京大学的公交车吗？
column2: Qǐngwèn, zhèr yǒu dào Běijīng Dàxué de gōngjiāochē ma?
column3: Excuse me, is there a bus to Peking University from here?

column1: 有，但车站有点儿远。
column2: Yǒu, dàn chēzhàn yǒudiǎnr yuǎn.
column3: Yes, but the bus stop is a bit far.

column1: 这儿好打车吗？
column2: Zhèr hǎo dǎ chē ma?
column3: Is it easy to get a taxi here?

column1: 好打车。
column2: Hǎo dǎ chē.
column3: Yes, easy.

column1: 谢谢。安妮，我们还是打车去吧。
column2: Xièxie. Ānnī, wǒmen háishi dǎ chē qù ba.
column3: Thanks. Annie, let's just take a taxi.

column1: 好，没问题。
column2: Hǎo, méi wèntí.
column3: Okay, no problem.

column1: 学校里人真多啊！
column2: Xuéxiào li rén zhēn duō a!
column3: There are so many people on campus!

column1: 是啊，北京大学有四万多名学生呢！
column2: Shì a, Běijīng Dàxué yǒu sì wàn duō míng xuésheng ne!
column3: Yeah, Peking University has over forty thousand students!

column1: 你是怎么知道的？
column2: Nǐ shì zěnme zhīdào de?
column3: How do you know?

column1: 是网上说的，网上还说北京大学有三千多名外国学生。
column2: Shì wǎng shàng shuō de, wǎng shàng hái shuō Běijīng Dàxué yǒu sānqiān duō míng wàiguó xuésheng.
column3: It said so online—it also said Peking University has over three thousand foreign students.

column1: 我也想来这儿学习。
column2: Wǒ yě xiǎng lái zhèr xuéxí.
column3: I'd like to study here too.

column1: 那边就有一间教室，我们去看一下吧。
column2: Nàbiān jiù yǒu yì jiān jiàoshì, wǒmen qù kàn yíxià ba.
column3: There's a classroom right over there—let's go take a look.

column1: 家月，你看，学校里有家电影院！
column2: Jiāyuè, nǐ kàn, xuéxiào li yǒu jiā diànyǐngyuàn!
column3: Jiayue, look—there's a cinema on campus!

column1: 是啊，电影院还不小。
column2: Shì a, diànyǐngyuàn hái bù xiǎo.
column3: Yeah, and it's not small either.

column1: 他们卖的电影票也很便宜。
column2: Tāmen mài de diànyǐngpiào yě hěn piányi.
column3: The movie tickets they sell are cheap too.

column1: 天啊！有的还不到二十块钱。
column2: Tiān a! Yǒude hái bú dào èrshí kuài qián.
column3: Wow! Some are even under twenty yuan.

column1: 那你想不想去看个电影？
column2: Nà nǐ xiǎng bu xiǎng qù kàn ge diànyǐng?
column3: So do you want to go see a movie?

column1: 还是别看电影了，北京大学本身就很好看！
column2: Háishi bié kàn diànyǐng le, Běijīng Dàxué běnshēn jiù hěn hǎokàn!
column3: Let's not watch a movie—Peking University itself is worth seeing!

column1: 北京大学很大，有四万多名学生。学校很漂亮，里边还有几家电影院，电影票也不贵，我们有时间还想再过来看个电影。
column2: Běijīng Dàxué hěn dà, yǒu sì wàn duō míng xuésheng. Xuéxiào hěn piàoliang, lǐbian hái yǒu jǐ jiā diànyǐngyuàn, diànyǐngpiào yě bú guì, wǒmen yǒu shíjiān hái xiǎng zài guòlai kàn ge diànyǐng.
column3: Peking University is huge, with over forty thousand students. The campus is beautiful, and there are several cinemas inside with cheap tickets—when we have time, we'd like to come back and watch a movie.

column1: 你快点儿吧。
column2: Nǐ kuài diǎnr ba.
column3: Hurry up.

column1: 没事，一雪姐说11点前到就可以。
column2: Méi shì, Yīxuě jiě shuō shíyī diǎn qián dào jiù kěyǐ.
column3: It's fine—Sister Yixue said it's okay as long as we arrive before eleven.

column1: 家月、安妮，快进来！我给你们介绍一下，这是孩子们的爷爷、奶奶。
column2: Jiāyuè, Ānnī, kuài jìnlai! Wǒ gěi nǐmen jièshào yíxià, zhè shì háizimen de yéye, nǎinai.
column3: Jiayue, Annie, come in! Let me introduce you—these are the children's grandpa and grandma.

column1: 爷爷、奶奶好！
column2: Yéye, nǎinai hǎo!
column3: Hello, Grandpa and Grandma!

column1: 这是送你们的礼物。
column2: Zhè shì sòng nǐmen de lǐwù.
column3: This is a gift for you.

column1: 你们太客气了，还拿这么多礼物来！
column2: Nǐmen tài kèqi le, hái ná zhème duō lǐwù lái!
column3: You're too kind—bringing so many gifts!

column1: 一雪姐，这是给孩子们准备的礼物。
column2: Yīxuě jiě, zhè shì gěi háizimen zhǔnbèi de lǐwù.
column3: Sister Yixue, these are gifts for the children.

column1: 谢谢！你们别客气，快坐吧！
column2: Xièxie! Nǐmen bié kèqi, kuài zuò ba!
column3: Thanks! Make yourselves at home—have a seat!

column1: 都12点了，我们吃饭吧。
column2: Dōu shí'èr diǎn le, wǒmen chī fàn ba.
column3: It's already twelve—let's eat.

column1: 这么多好吃的，您太会做菜了！
column2: Zhème duō hǎochī de, nín tài huì zuò cài le!
column3: So much delicious food—you're a wonderful cook!

column1: 都是我自己做的，你们多吃点儿。
column2: Dōu shì wǒ zìjǐ zuò de, nǐmen duō chī diǎnr.
column3: I made it all myself—help yourselves to more.

column1: 奶茶也很好喝，是您自己做的吗？
column2: Nǎichá yě hěn hǎohē, shì nín zìjǐ zuò de ma?
column3: The milk tea is delicious too—did you make it yourself?

column1: 不是，奶茶是爷爷买的。
column2: Bú shì, nǎichá shì yéye mǎi de.
column3: No, Grandpa bought the milk tea.

column1: 在哪儿买的？我还没喝过这么好喝的奶茶。
column2: Zài nǎr mǎi de? Wǒ hái méi hēguo zhème hǎohē de nǎichá.
column3: Where did he buy it? I've never had such good milk tea.

column1: 就在前边的商场，吃完饭你们可以跟我去看看。
column2: Jiù zài qiánbian de shāngchǎng, chī wán fàn nǐmen kěyǐ gēn wǒ qù kànkan.
column3: At the mall up ahead—after the meal you can come with me to have a look.

column1: 回国前一天，我们去一雪姐家了。到她家的时候，饭菜都做好了。刘爷爷还准备了奶茶。因为吃了太多东西，我们吃完饭是走回酒店的。
column2: Huí guó qián yì tiān, wǒmen qù Yīxuě jiě jiā le. Dào tā jiā de shíhou, fàncài dōu zuò hǎo le. Liú yéye hái zhǔnbèi le nǎichá. Yīnwèi chī le tài duō dōngxi, wǒmen chī wán fàn shì zǒu huí jiǔdiàn de.
column3: The day before returning home, we went to Sister Yixue's place. By the time we arrived, the meal was ready. Grandpa Liu had also prepared milk tea. Because we ate too much, we walked back to the hotel after the meal.

column1: 明天就是女儿的生日了。
column2: Míngtiān jiù shì nǚ'ér de shēngrì le.
column3: Tomorrow is our daughter's birthday.

column1: 你不说，我还真忘了。我们给她准备个什么礼物呢？
column2: Nǐ bù shuō, wǒ hái zhēn wàng le. Wǒmen gěi tā zhǔnbèi ge shénme lǐwù ne?
column3: If you hadn't mentioned it, I'd have forgotten. What gift should we get her?

column1: 她喜欢画画，你觉得画笔怎么样？
column2: Tā xǐhuan huà huà, nǐ juéde huàbǐ zěnmeyàng?
column3: She likes drawing—how about some paintbrushes?

column1: 就送画笔吧！
column2: Jiù sòng huàbǐ ba!
column3: Paintbrushes it is!

column1: 那我明天上午就去买。
column2: Nà wǒ míngtiān shàngwǔ jiù qù mǎi.
column3: Then I'll go buy them tomorrow morning.

column1: 好！我再给她买个大大的生日蛋糕。
column2: Hǎo! Wǒ zài gěi tā mǎi ge dàdà de shēngrì dàngāo.
column3: Great! And I'll buy her a big birthday cake.

column1: 小雪，生日快乐！
column2: Xiǎoxuě, shēngrì kuàilè!
column3: Xiaoxue, happy birthday!

column1: 姐姐，生日快乐！
column2: Jiějie, shēngrì kuàilè!
column3: Happy birthday, big sister!

column1: 小雪，这是爸爸、妈妈送你的礼物。
column2: Xiǎoxuě, zhè shì bàba, māma sòng nǐ de lǐwù.
column3: Xiaoxue, this is a gift from Mom and Dad.

column1: 你打开看看喜欢不喜欢。
column2: Nǐ dǎkāi kànkan xǐhuan bu xǐhuan.
column3: Open it and see if you like it.

column1: 画笔！我很喜欢！
column2: Huàbǐ! Wǒ hěn xǐhuan!
column3: Paintbrushes! I love them!

column1: 你想画什么？
column2: Nǐ xiǎng huà shénme?
column3: What do you want to draw?

column1: 画我们的家！有爸爸、妈妈、弟弟，还有黑色的狗、白色的猫什么的。
column2: Huà wǒmen de jiā! Yǒu bàba, māma, dìdi, háiyǒu hēisè de gǒu, báisè de māo shénme de.
column3: Our family! With Dad, Mom, little brother, and a black dog, a white cat, and so on.

column1: 那我要画一个穿白色衣服的姐姐。
column2: Nà wǒ yào huà yí ge chuān báisè yīfu de jiějie.
column3: Then I'll draw my big sister in white clothes.

column1: 小雪，看看今天有什么好吃的。
column2: Xiǎoxuě, kànkan jīntiān yǒu shénme hǎochī de.
column3: Xiaoxue, look at all the good food today.

column1: 长长的面条儿，大大的蛋糕。
column2: Chángcháng de miàntiáor, dàdà de dàngāo.
column3: Long noodles and a big cake.

column1: 你看，还有鱼啊肉啊什么的，都是你喜欢吃的。
column2: Nǐ kàn, háiyǒu yú a ròu a shénme de, dōu shì nǐ xǐhuan chī de.
column3: Look, there's fish and meat and so on—all your favorites.

column1: 谢谢爸爸、妈妈！
column2: Xièxie bàba, māma!
column3: Thank you, Mom and Dad!

column1: 快去叫弟弟过来吃饭吧，吃完饭我们还要出去玩呢。
column2: Kuài qù jiào dìdi guòlai chī fàn ba, chī wán fàn wǒmen hái yào chūqu wán ne.
column3: Go call your little brother to come eat—after the meal we're going out to have fun.

column1: 生日真好啊！
column2: Shēngrì zhēn hǎo a!
column3: Birthdays are wonderful!

column1: 是的，过生日就要吃好吃的，还要高高兴兴地玩。
column2: Shì de, guò shēngrì jiù yào chī hǎochī de, hái yào gāogāoxìngxìng de wán.
column3: Yes—on your birthday you eat good food and have a joyful time.

column1: 今天是女儿的生日。我们买了蛋糕，做了面条儿，还做了鱼啊肉啊什么的。吃完晚饭，一家人去看了个电影。回家后，孩子们早早地就上床了。明天不上学，他们说要舒舒服服地睡一觉，让我们晚点儿叫他们起床。这是很忙、很累，但很快乐的一天。
column2: Jīntiān shì nǚ'ér de shēngrì. Wǒmen mǎi le dàngāo, zuò le miàntiáor, hái zuò le yú a ròu a shénme de. Chī wán wǎnfàn, yìjiā rén qù kàn le ge diànyǐng. Huí jiā hòu, háizimen zǎozǎo de jiù shàngchuáng le. Míngtiān bú shàngxué, tāmen shuō yào shūshūfúfú de shuì yí jiào, ràng wǒmen wǎn diǎnr jiào tāmen qǐchuáng. Zhè shì hěn máng, hěn lèi, dàn hěn kuàilè de yì tiān.
column3: Today is our daughter's birthday. We bought a cake, made noodles, and cooked fish, meat, and so on. After dinner, the whole family went to see a movie. Back home, the children went to bed early. There's no school tomorrow, so they said they want to sleep in comfortably and asked us to wake them up later. It was a busy, tiring, but very happy day.

column1: 安妮，你是什么时候从北京回来的？
column2: Ānnī, nǐ shì shénme shíhou cóng Běijīng huílai de?
column3: Annie, when did you get back from Beijing?

column1: 昨天下午。天中，你怎么一下课就往外跑？
column2: Zuótiān xiàwǔ. Tiānzhōng, nǐ zěnme yí xiàkè jiù wǎng wài pǎo?
column3: Yesterday afternoon. Tianzhong, why do you dash outside the moment class ends?

column1: 我跟同学说好了，一起去打篮球。
column2: Wǒ gēn tóngxué shuōhǎo le, yìqǐ qù dǎ lánqiú.
column3: I arranged with classmates to go play basketball together.

column1: 我也想跟你们一起玩。
column2: Wǒ yě xiǎng gēn nǐmen yìqǐ wán.
column3: I'd like to join you too.

column1: 没问题，走吧。
column2: Méi wèntí, zǒu ba.
column3: No problem, let's go.

column1: 天中，你是不是很喜欢打篮球？
column2: Tiānzhōng, nǐ shì bu shì hěn xǐhuan dǎ lánqiú?
column3: Tianzhong, do you really like playing basketball?

column1: 没错。
column2: Méicuò.
column3: That's right.

column1: 你还喜欢什么运动？
column2: Nǐ hái xǐhuan shénme yùndòng?
column3: What other sports do you like?

column1: 我还喜欢踢足球，一到星期天就跟朋友们一起踢。
column2: Wǒ hái xǐhuan tī zúqiú, yí dào xīngqītiān jiù gēn péngyoumen yìqǐ tī.
column3: I also like soccer—every Sunday I play with friends.

column1: 你踢得怎么样？
column2: Nǐ tī de zěnmeyàng?
column3: How well do you play?

column1: 我踢得还可以。
column2: Wǒ tī de hái kěyǐ.
column3: I play okay.

column1: 你篮球打得怎么样？
column2: Nǐ lánqiú dǎ de zěnmeyàng?
column3: How well do you play basketball?

column1: 打得还可以。
column2: Dǎ de hái kěyǐ.
column3: I play okay.

column1: 你跑得快不快？
column2: Nǐ pǎo de kuài bu kuài?
column3: Do you run fast?

column1: 我跑得不快，也不太喜欢跑步。
column2: Wǒ pǎo de bú kuài, yě bú tài xǐhuan pǎobù.
column3: I don't run fast, and I don't really like running.

column1: 那你喜欢游泳吗？
column2: Nà nǐ xǐhuan yóuyǒng ma?
column3: Then do you like swimming?

column1: 喜欢，但我游泳游得不快。
column2: Xǐhuan, dàn wǒ yóuyǒng yóu de bú kuài.
column3: Yes, but I don't swim fast.

column1: 我的爱好是运动。从上小学开始，我每天都跟爸爸去运动。现在我篮球打得很好，足球踢得不错，游泳游得也很快。我一有时间就去运动。
column2: Wǒ de àihào shì yùndòng. Cóng shàng xiǎoxué kāishǐ, wǒ měi tiān dōu gēn bàba qù yùndòng. Xiànzài wǒ lánqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo, zúqiú tī de búcuò, yóuyǒng yóu de yě hěn kuài. Wǒ yì yǒu shíjiān jiù qù yùndòng.
column3: My hobby is sports. Ever since primary school, I've gone exercising with my dad every day. Now I play basketball very well, soccer pretty well, and swim fast too. Whenever I have time, I go exercise.

column1: 你看，这两块手表怎么样？
column2: Nǐ kàn, zhè liǎng kuài shǒubiǎo zěnmeyàng?
column3: Look—what do you think of these two watches?

column1: 都不错！
column2: Dōu búcuò!
column3: Both are nice!

column1: 我喜欢左边这个。
column2: Wǒ xǐhuan zuǒbian zhège.
column3: I like the one on the left.

column1: 我也觉得左边的比右边的好看。
column2: Wǒ yě juéde zuǒbian de bǐ yòubian de hǎokàn.
column3: I also think the left one looks better than the right one.

column1: 你看看要多少钱！
column2: Nǐ kànkan yào duōshao qián!
column3: Look at how much it costs!

column1: 不便宜！8800元！
column2: Bù piányi! Bāqiān bā bǎi yuán!
column3: Not cheap! 8,800 yuan!

column1: 今天有不少电影，我们看个电影吧。
column2: Jīntiān yǒu bù shǎo diànyǐng, wǒmen kàn ge diànyǐng ba.
column3: There are lots of movies today—let's watch one.

column1: 好啊！我们看哪个？
column2: Hǎo a! Wǒmen kàn nǎge?
column3: Sure! Which one should we watch?

column1: 我记得你喜欢看爱情片，我们看那个爱情片，怎么样？
column2: Wǒ jìde nǐ xǐhuan kàn àiqíngpiàn, wǒmen kàn nàge àiqíngpiàn, zěnmeyàng?
column3: I remember you like romance films—how about that romance one?

column1: 还是看这个吧，我看网上说这个电影比那个爱情片更有意思。
column2: Háishi kàn zhège ba, wǒ kàn wǎng shàng shuō zhège diànyǐng bǐ nàge àiqíngpiàn gèng yǒu yìsi.
column3: Let's watch this one instead—online it says this movie is more interesting than that romance film.

column1: 好啊，我去买票。
column2: Hǎo a, wǒ qù mǎi piào.
column3: Okay, I'll go buy tickets.

column1: 到网上买吧，网上买比在这里买便宜。
column2: Dào wǎng shàng mǎi ba, wǎng shàng mǎi bǐ zài zhèlǐ mǎi piányi.
column3: Buy them online—it's cheaper than buying here.

column1: 您好！就要这几个菜吧，谢谢！
column2: Nín hǎo! Jiù yào zhè jǐ ge cài ba, xièxie!
column3: Hello! We'll just have these dishes, thanks!

column1: 怎么点这么多菜？
column2: Zěnme diǎn zhème duō cài?
column3: Why did you order so many dishes?

column1: 你想想，今天是几月几号？
column2: Nǐ xiǎngxiang, jīntiān shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?
column3: Think about it—what's the date today?

column1: 8月27号。啊！我的生日！
column2: Bā yuè èrshíqī hào. À! Wǒ de shēngrì!
column3: August 27th. Oh! My birthday!

column1: 生日快乐！虽然你忘了，但是我记得。看看这是什么？
column2: Shēngrì kuàilè! Suīrán nǐ wàng le, dànshì wǒ jìde. Kànkan zhè shì shénme?
column3: Happy birthday! Even though you forgot, I remembered. Look, what's this?

column1: 手表！吃饭、看电影、买手表，今天花了不少钱吧？
column2: Shǒubiǎo! Chī fàn, kàn diànyǐng, mǎi shǒubiǎo, jīntiān huā le bù shǎo qián ba?
column3: A watch! Dinner, a movie, a watch—you spent quite a lot today, didn't you?

column1: 虽然花了一些钱，但是我们过了一个快乐的生日。
column2: Suīrán huā le yìxiē qián, dànshì wǒmen guò le yí ge kuàilè de shēngrì.
column3: We spent some money, but we had a happy birthday.

column1: 虽然妻子忘了今天是自己的生日，但是丈夫记得。丈夫请妻子去饭馆吃饭、去电影院看电影，还给妻子买了一块非常漂亮的手表。妻子觉得今天很快乐。
column2: Suīrán qīzi wàng le jīntiān shì zìjǐ de shēngrì, dànshì zhàngfu jìde. Zhàngfu qǐng qīzi qù fànguǎn chī fàn, qù diànyǐngyuàn kàn diànyǐng, hái gěi qīzi mǎi le yí kuài fēicháng piàoliang de shǒubiǎo. Qīzi juéde jīntiān hěn kuàilè.
column3: Although the wife forgot it was her own birthday, the husband remembered. He took her to a restaurant for dinner and to the cinema for a movie, and bought her a very beautiful watch. The wife felt very happy today.

column1: 儿子的裤子坏了，我们给他买条新的吧。
column2: Érzi de kùzi huài le, wǒmen gěi tā mǎi tiáo xīn de ba.
column3: Our son's pants are worn out—let's buy him a new pair.

column1: 好。
column2: Hǎo.
column3: Okay.

column1: 你看这条黑色的怎么样？
column2: Nǐ kàn zhè tiáo hēisè de zěnmeyàng?
column3: What do you think of these black ones?

column1: 没有你上次买的那条好看。
column2: Méiyǒu nǐ shàng cì mǎi de nà tiáo hǎokàn.
column3: Not as nice as the pair you bought last time.

column1: 旁边那个男孩儿就穿了这样的裤子，我觉得很好看啊！
column2: Pángbiān nàge nánháir jiù chuān le zhèyàng de kùzi, wǒ juéde hěn hǎokàn a!
column3: That boy next to us is wearing pants like these—I think they look great!

column1: 儿子的个子没有他那么高，穿上就不会太好看。
column2: Érzi de gèzi méiyǒu tā nàme gāo, chuān shàng jiù bú huì tài hǎokàn.
column3: Our son isn't as tall as him, so they wouldn't look as good on him.

column1: 好吧，我们再去那边看看。
column2: Hǎo ba, wǒmen zài qù nàbiān kànkan.
column3: All right, let's go look over there.

column1: 门口有家奶茶店。你想喝杯奶茶吗？
column2: Ménkǒu yǒu jiā nǎichádiàn. Nǐ xiǎng hē bēi nǎichá ma?
column3: There's a milk tea shop at the entrance. Would you like a cup of milk tea?

column1: 我想喝咖啡，我们去咖啡店吧。
column2: Wǒ xiǎng hē kāfēi, wǒmen qù kāfēidiàn ba.
column3: I'd like coffee—let's go to a coffee shop.

column1: 咖啡店离这儿有点儿远。
column2: Kāfēidiàn lí zhèr yǒudiǎnr yuǎn.
column3: The coffee shop is a bit far from here.

column1: 没关系，那家店的咖啡很好喝。
column2: Méi guānxi, nà jiā diàn de kāfēi hěn hǎohē.
column3: It's fine—that shop's coffee is really good.

column1: 那你等一下，我去买杯奶茶。
column2: Nà nǐ děng yíxià, wǒ qù mǎi bēi nǎichá.
column3: Then wait a sec—I'll go get a cup of milk tea.

column1: 你不想喝咖啡吗？
column2: Nǐ bù xiǎng hē kāfēi ma?
column3: Don't you want coffee?

column1: 喝了咖啡，晚上就睡不着觉了。
column2: Hē le kāfēi, wǎnshang jiù shuìbuzháo jiào le.
column3: If I drink coffee, I won't be able to sleep at night.

column1: 我们打车回去吧。
column2: Wǒmen dǎ chē huíqu ba.
column3: Let's take a taxi back.

column1: 这里离家很近，还是走路吧。
column2: Zhèlǐ lí jiā hěn jìn, háishi zǒulù ba.
column3: Home is close from here—let's just walk.

column1: 要走多长时间？
column2: Yào zǒu duō cháng shíjiān?
column3: How long is the walk?

column1: 走半个多小时就到了。
column2: Zǒu bàn ge duō xiǎoshí jiù dào le.
column3: About half an hour on foot.

column1: 好的。每天上下班都开车，今天运动运动吧。
column2: Hǎo de. Měi tiān shàng-xiàbān dōu kāichē, jīntiān yùndòng yùndòng ba.
column3: Okay. We drive to and from work every day—let's get some exercise today.

column1: 这周刘明休息，我下班后跟他去了一家商店。商店里边的衣服没有大商场里的好看。我们没有买到喜欢的衣服，从商店出来就到咖啡店坐了坐。因为想运动运动，所以喝完东西，我们就走回家了。
column2: Zhè zhōu Liú Míng xiūxi, wǒ xiàbān hòu gēn tā qù le yì jiā shāngdiàn. Shāngdiàn lǐbian de yīfu méiyǒu dà shāngchǎng li de hǎokàn. Wǒmen méiyǒu mǎidào xǐhuan de yīfu, cóng shāngdiàn chūlai jiù dào kāfēidiàn zuò le zuò. Yīnwèi xiǎng yùndòng yùndòng, suǒyǐ hē wán dōngxi, wǒmen jiù zǒu huí jiā le.
column3: Liu Ming was off this week, so after work I went with him to a store. The clothes in the store weren't as nice as those in a big mall. We didn't find any clothes we liked, so after leaving we sat for a while at a coffee shop. Because we wanted some exercise, after our drinks we walked home.

column1: 小明，你们明天开学，你准备好了吗？
column2: Xiǎo Míng, nǐmen míngtiān kāixué, nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?
column3: Xiao Ming, school starts tomorrow—are you ready?

column1: 明天就开学啊？爸爸，我的书包你看见了吗？
column2: Míngtiān jiù kāixué a? Bàba, wǒ de shūbāo nǐ kànjiàn le ma?
column3: School starts tomorrow already? Dad, have you seen my schoolbag?

column1: 书包在门后面。
column2: Shūbāo zài mén hòumiàn.
column3: The schoolbag is behind the door.

column1: 书在哪儿呢？笔呢？
column2: Shū zài nǎr ne? Bǐ ne?
column3: Where are my books? And my pens?

column1: 书在床上，笔在桌子上。
column2: Shū zài chuáng shàng, bǐ zài zhuōzi shàng.
column3: The books are on the bed, and the pens are on the desk.

column1: 太好了！现在都准备好了。
column2: Tài hǎo le! Xiànzài dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
column3: Great! Everything's ready now.

column1: 这次爸爸帮你，下次你自己准备，好不好？
column2: Zhè cì bàba bāng nǐ, xià cì nǐ zìjǐ zhǔnbèi, hǎo bu hǎo?
column3: This time Dad helped you; next time you prepare it yourself, okay?

column1: 好！
column2: Hǎo!
column3: Okay!

column1: 小雪，你在做什么呢？
column2: Xiǎoxuě, nǐ zài zuò shénme ne?
column3: Xiaoxue, what are you doing?

column1: 明天就要考试了，我在看书。
column2: Míngtiān jiù yào kǎoshì le, wǒ zài kàn shū.
column3: There's an exam tomorrow, so I'm studying.

column1: 这些词要好好看看。
column2: Zhèxiē cí yào hǎohǎo kànkan.
column3: Study these words carefully.

column1: 我看过了，意思也都懂了。
column2: Wǒ kànguo le, yìsi yě dōu dǒng le.
column3: I've gone over them and understand all the meanings.

column1: 你的本子呢？本子上做错的题也要看一看。
column2: Nǐ de běnzi ne? Běnzi shàng zuòcuò de tí yě yào kàn yi kàn.
column3: Where's your notebook? Look over the questions you got wrong in it too.

column1: 妈妈，是您准备考试还是我准备考试？
column2: Māma, shì nín zhǔnbèi kǎoshì háishi wǒ zhǔnbèi kǎoshì?
column3: Mom, is it you taking the exam or me?

column1: 妈妈，我回来了！
column2: Māma, wǒ huílai le!
column3: Mom, I'm home!

column1: 我买了奶茶，就在桌子上，自己去拿吧。
column2: Wǒ mǎi le nǎichá, jiù zài zhuōzi shàng, zìjǐ qù ná ba.
column3: I bought milk tea—it's on the table, go help yourself.

column1: 谢谢妈妈！
column2: Xièxie māma!
column3: Thanks, Mom!

column1: 今天考试考得怎么样？
column2: Jīntiān kǎoshì kǎo de zěnmeyàng?
column3: How did the exam go today?

column1: 我觉得比上次好。
column2: Wǒ juéde bǐ shàng cì hǎo.
column3: I think it went better than last time.

column1: 真不错！饭菜快要做好了，你叫弟弟一起去洗手吧。
column2: Zhēn búcuò! Fàncài kuài yào zuò hǎo le, nǐ jiào dìdi yìqǐ qù xǐ shǒu ba.
column3: Great! Dinner's almost ready—go call your little brother to wash hands with you.

column1: 妈妈，我是第一名，姐姐还没洗完呢。
column2: Māma, wǒ shì dì-yī míng, jiějie hái méi xǐ wán ne.
column3: Mom, I'm first—big sister hasn't finished washing yet.

column1: 你洗得真快啊！
column2: Nǐ xǐ de zhēn kuài a!
column3: You washed up really fast!

column1: 快要开学了，爸爸帮弟弟准备书包、本子和笔。我就要考试了，妈妈让我看书、看做错的题。我们上学，爸爸、妈妈比我们还忙。我问他们：“是我和弟弟上学还是你们上学？”我问完，他们都笑了。
column2: Kuài yào kāixué le, bàba bāng dìdi zhǔnbèi shūbāo, běnzi hé bǐ. Wǒ jiù yào kǎoshì le, māma ràng wǒ kàn shū, kàn zuòcuò de tí. Wǒmen shàngxué, bàba, māma bǐ wǒmen hái máng. Wǒ wèn tāmen: "shì wǒ hé dìdi shàngxué háishi nǐmen shàngxué?" Wǒ wèn wán, tāmen dōu xiào le.
column3: School's about to start, and Dad is helping my little brother pack his schoolbag, notebooks, and pens. I have an exam coming up, and Mom has me study and review the questions I got wrong. When we go to school, Mom and Dad are even busier than we are. I asked them, "Is it my brother and me going to school, or you two?" After I asked, they both laughed.

column1: 家月，都下课了，你怎么还不回家？
column2: Jiāyuè, dōu xiàkè le, nǐ zěnme hái bù huí jiā?
column3: Jiayue, class is over—why aren't you going home yet?

column1: 我头疼，不太舒服。
column2: Wǒ tóu téng, bú tài shūfu.
column3: I have a headache and don't feel well.

column1: 你这几天经常头疼，去医院看看吧。
column2: Nǐ zhè jǐ tiān jīngcháng tóu téng, qù yīyuàn kànkan ba.
column3: You've had headaches often these days—go see a doctor.

column1: 我想休息一下，现在不能动，一动就疼。
column2: Wǒ xiǎng xiūxi yíxià, xiànzài bù néng dòng, yí dòng jiù téng.
column3: I want to rest—I can't move now; it hurts the moment I do.

column1: 那你在这儿坐着，我去开车，一会儿送你去医院。
column2: Nà nǐ zài zhèr zuòzhe, wǒ qù kāichē, yíhuìr sòng nǐ qù yīyuàn.
column3: Then sit here—I'll get the car and take you to the hospital in a bit.

column1: 谢谢王老师。
column2: Xièxie Wáng lǎoshī.
column3: Thank you, Teacher Wang.

column1: 现在路上车多，还下着雪，我开慢一点儿。
column2: Xiànzài lù shàng chē duō, hái xiàzhe xuě, wǒ kāi màn yìdiǎnr.
column3: There's heavy traffic now and it's snowing, so I'll drive slowly.

column1: 没问题，现在头没那么疼了。
column2: Méi wèntí, xiànzài tóu méi nàme téng le.
column3: No problem—my head doesn't hurt as much now.

column1: 好。李文来电话了，你帮我接一下。
column2: Hǎo. Lǐ Wén lái diànhuà le, nǐ bāng wǒ jiē yíxià.
column3: Okay. Li Wen is calling—answer it for me.

column1: 喂，李文，王老师开着车呢，你找她有事吗？
column2: Wéi, Lǐ Wén, Wáng lǎoshī kāizhe chē ne, nǐ zhǎo tā yǒu shì ma?
column3: Hello, Li Wen, Teacher Wang is driving—did you need her for something?

column1: 没什么事。今天雪这么大，你们开车去哪儿啊？
column2: Méi shénme shì. Jīntiān xuě zhème dà, nǐmen kāichē qù nǎr a?
column3: Nothing much. The snow's so heavy today—where are you two driving to?

column1: 去医院，我头有点儿疼。
column2: Qù yīyuàn, wǒ tóu yǒudiǎnr téng.
column3: To the hospital—I have a bit of a headache.

column1: 那我一会儿去看看你。
column2: Nà wǒ yíhuìr qù kànkan nǐ.
column3: Then I'll come see you in a bit.

column1: 李文，快请进！
column2: Lǐ Wén, kuài qǐng jìn!
column3: Li Wen, come in!

column1: 家月，你怎么样了？头还疼吗？
column2: Jiāyuè, nǐ zěnmeyàng le? Tóu hái téng ma?
column3: Jiayue, how are you? Does your head still hurt?

column1: 不那么疼了。医生开了一些药，吃完就好多了。
column2: Bú nàme téng le. Yīshēng kāi le yìxiē yào, chī wán jiù hǎo duō le.
column3: Not as much. The doctor prescribed some medicine, and after taking it I feel much better.

column1: 那就好！
column2: Nà jiù hǎo!
column3: That's good!

column1: 家月，你想不想吃点儿东西？
column2: Jiāyuè, nǐ xiǎng bu xiǎng chī diǎnr dōngxi?
column3: Jiayue, would you like something to eat?

column1: 吃点儿吧，身体不舒服时更要好好吃饭。
column2: Chī diǎnr ba, shēntǐ bù shūfu shí gèng yào hǎohǎo chī fàn.
column3: Have a little—when you're unwell you should eat properly all the more.

column1: 吃点儿什么呢？
column2: Chī diǎnr shénme ne?
column3: What should I eat?

column1: 你最喜欢吃中国菜，我做几个中国菜吧。
column2: Nǐ zuì xǐhuan chī Zhōngguó cài, wǒ zuò jǐ ge Zhōngguó cài ba.
column3: You love Chinese food most—I'll cook a few Chinese dishes.

column1: 好的，谢谢王老师。
column2: Hǎo de, xièxie Wáng lǎoshī.
column3: Okay, thank you, Teacher Wang.

column1: 我这几天经常头疼，从药店买了点儿药，没去医院。今天下课后，王老师看我不舒服，就送我去医院了。从医院回来，李文也来看我了。现在他们都回去了，我也要睡觉了。
column2: Wǒ zhè jǐ tiān jīngcháng tóu téng, cóng yàodiàn mǎi le diǎnr yào, méi qù yīyuàn. Jīntiān xiàkè hòu, Wáng lǎoshī kàn wǒ bù shūfu, jiù sòng wǒ qù yīyuàn le. Cóng yīyuàn huílai, Lǐ Wén yě lái kàn wǒ le. Xiànzài tāmen dōu huíqu le, wǒ yě yào shuìjiào le.
column3: I've had frequent headaches these days; I bought some medicine at the pharmacy and didn't go to the hospital. After class today, Teacher Wang saw I was unwell and took me to the hospital. After I got back, Li Wen came to see me too. Now they've all left, and I'm going to sleep.

column1: 喂，家月，是你啊！有什么事情吗？
column2: Wéi, Jiāyuè, shì nǐ a! Yǒu shénme shìqing ma?
column3: Hello, Jiayue, it's you! Is something up?

column1: 没什么事，就想跟您说说话。
column2: Méi shénme shì, jiù xiǎng gēn nín shuōshuo huà.
column3: Nothing much—I just wanted to chat with you.

column1: 好啊。你今天没课吗？
column2: Hǎo a. Nǐ jīntiān méi kè ma?
column3: Sure. Don't you have class today?

column1: 下午有课。您那里天气怎么样？
column2: Xiàwǔ yǒu kè. Nín nàli tiānqì zěnmeyàng?
column3: I have class in the afternoon. How's the weather where you are?

column1: 北京这几天虽然是晴天，但是有点儿冷。
column2: Běijīng zhè jǐ tiān suīrán shì qíngtiān, dànshì yǒudiǎnr lěng.
column3: Beijing has been sunny these days, but a bit cold.

column1: 我这里比北京冷多了，外边还正下着雪呢！
column2: Wǒ zhèlǐ bǐ Běijīng lěng duō le, wàibian hái zhèng xiàzhe xuě ne!
column3: It's much colder here than in Beijing—it's even snowing outside right now!

column1: 喂，一飞，听家月说你那边下雪了，下得大不大？
column2: Wéi, Yīfēi, tīng Jiāyuè shuō nǐ nàbiān xià xuě le, xià de dà bu dà?
column3: Hello, Yifei, Jiayue says it's snowing where you are—is it heavy?

column1: 今天不大，昨天比今天下得大。
column2: Jīntiān bú dà, zuótiān bǐ jīntiān xià de dà.
column3: Not today; it snowed harder yesterday than today.

column1: 天气不好，你去外面的时候多穿点儿衣服。
column2: Tiānqì bù hǎo, nǐ qù wàimiàn de shíhou duō chuān diǎnr yīfu.
column3: The weather's bad—dress warmly when you go out.

column1: 这几天我在网上上课，没出去过。
column2: Zhè jǐ tiān wǒ zài wǎng shàng shàngkè, méi chūqu guo.
column3: These days I've been taking classes online and haven't gone out.

column1: 那就好，有事记得给我打电话。
column2: Nà jiù hǎo, yǒu shì jìde gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
column3: That's good—remember to call me if anything comes up.

column1: 好的。现在不下雪了，我出去买点儿吃的。
column2: Hǎo de. Xiànzài bú xià xuě le, wǒ chūqu mǎi diǎnr chī de.
column3: Okay. It's stopped snowing now—I'll go out and buy some food.

column1: 一次多买点儿，阴天下雪什么的就少出去吧。
column2: Yí cì duō mǎi diǎnr, yīntiān xià xuě shénme de jiù shǎo chūqu ba.
column3: Buy more at once, and go out less on cloudy or snowy days.

column1: 喂，家月，今天天气不错，我们去跑步吧！
column2: Wéi, Jiāyuè, jīntiān tiānqì búcuò, wǒmen qù pǎobù ba!
column3: Hello, Jiayue, the weather's nice today—let's go for a run!

column1: 你跑步跑得比我快，我们能一起跑吗？
column2: Nǐ pǎobù pǎo de bǐ wǒ kuài, wǒmen néng yìqǐ pǎo ma?
column3: You run faster than me—can we run together?

column1: 可以的，我慢慢跑，等你。
column2: Kěyǐ de, wǒ mànmàn pǎo, děng nǐ.
column3: Sure—I'll run slowly and wait for you.

column1: 好吧。你真爱跑步啊！
column2: Hǎo ba. Nǐ zhēn ài pǎobù a!
column3: Okay. You really love running!

column1: 我小时候经常跑步，跑步能让人快乐！
column2: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou jīngcháng pǎobù, pǎobù néng ràng rén kuàilè!
column3: I ran a lot as a kid—running makes you happy!

column1: 好，那我准备一下。
column2: Hǎo, nà wǒ zhǔnbèi yíxià.
column3: Okay, then let me get ready.

column1: 我现在坐地铁去找你，一会儿楼下见。
column2: Wǒ xiànzài zuò dìtiě qù zhǎo nǐ, yíhuìr lóuxià jiàn.
column3: I'll take the subway to meet you now—see you downstairs soon.

column1: 前几天天气不好，我没走路，每天坐两站地铁去学校。今天是个大晴天，李文让我跟他去外面跑步。他小时候经常跑步，跑得比我快，但是他会等我。跟李文一起跑步，我好高兴啊！
column2: Qián jǐ tiān tiānqì bù hǎo, wǒ méi zǒulù, měi tiān zuò liǎng zhàn dìtiě qù xuéxiào. Jīntiān shì ge dà qíngtiān, Lǐ Wén ràng wǒ gēn tā qù wàimiàn pǎobù. Tā xiǎoshíhou jīngcháng pǎobù, pǎo de bǐ wǒ kuài, dànshì tā huì děng wǒ. Gēn Lǐ Wén yìqǐ pǎobù, wǒ hǎo gāoxìng a!
column3: The weather was bad the past few days, so I didn't walk—I took the subway two stops to school each day. Today is a bright sunny day, and Li Wen invited me to go running outside with him. He ran a lot as a kid and runs faster than me, but he waits for me. Running with Li Wen makes me so happy!

column1: 时间过得真快啊！新年就要到了。
column2: Shíjiān guò de zhēn kuài a! Xīnnián jiù yào dào le.
column3: Time flies! The New Year is almost here.

column1: 这一年王老师教我们中文，每天工作都很累。
column2: Zhè yì nián Wáng lǎoshī jiāo wǒmen Zhōngwén, měi tiān gōngzuò dōu hěn lèi.
column3: This year Teacher Wang taught us Chinese, and her work was tiring every day.

column1: 是啊，她教得很好。因为她，我们都非常爱上中文课。
column2: Shì a, tā jiāo de hěn hǎo. Yīnwèi tā, wǒmen dōu fēicháng ài shàng Zhōngwén kè.
column3: Yeah, she teaches very well. Because of her, we all love going to Chinese class.

column1: 我们给她准备个新年礼物吧。你觉得送给她什么好呢？
column2: Wǒmen gěi tā zhǔnbèi ge xīnnián lǐwù ba. Nǐ juéde sòng gěi tā shénme hǎo ne?
column3: Let's get her a New Year gift. What do you think we should give her?

column1: 王老师喜欢花，就送给她花吧。
column2: Wáng lǎoshī xǐhuan huā, jiù sòng gěi tā huā ba.
column3: Teacher Wang likes flowers—let's give her flowers.

column1: 那我们去花店看看，现在买花的人多，希望花店还有漂亮的花。
column2: Nà wǒmen qù huādiàn kànkan, xiànzài mǎi huā de rén duō, xīwàng huādiàn hái yǒu piàoliang de huā.
column3: Then let's check the flower shop—lots of people are buying flowers now; I hope the shop still has some pretty ones.

column1: 王老师，今天的词比昨天多了十个。
column2: Wáng lǎoshī, jīntiān de cí bǐ zuótiān duō le shí ge.
column3: Teacher Wang, there are ten more words today than yesterday.

column1: 是啊！你们都学会了吗？
column2: Shì a! Nǐmen dōu xuéhuì le ma?
column3: Yes! Have you all learned them?

column1: 学会了，没有问题。
column2: Xuéhuì le, méiyǒu wèntí.
column3: Yes, no problem.

column1: 好。现在我来说，你们在本子上面写。
column2: Hǎo. Xiànzài wǒ lái shuō, nǐmen zài běnzi shàngmiàn xiě.
column3: Good. Now I'll say them, and you write them in your notebooks.

column1: 同学们，“洗手间”的“间”字写错了，它的里面是“日”，不是“口”。
column2: Tóngxuémen, "xǐshǒujiān" de "jiān" zì xiěcuò le, tā de lǐmiàn shì "rì", bú shì "kǒu".
column3: Class, the character "jiān" in "restroom" is written wrong—inside it is "日" (rì), not "口" (kǒu).

column1: “日”比“口”多一笔，写“口”就是“问题”的“问”了。
column2: Rì bǐ "kǒu" duō yì bǐ, xiě "kǒu" jiù shì "wèntí" de "wèn" le.
column3: 日 has one more stroke than "口"; if you write "口", it becomes the "wèn" in "wèntí" (question).

column1: 没错，你说得很对。
column2: Méicuò, nǐ shuō de hěn duì.
column3: Exactly, you're quite right.

column1: 家月，你觉得这个本子怎么样？
column2: Jiāyuè, nǐ juéde zhège běnzi zěnmeyàng?
column3: Jiayue, what do you think of this notebook?

column1: 很漂亮，多少钱一个？
column2: Hěn piàoliang, duōshao qián yí ge?
column3: Very nice—how much each?

column1: 比我们一起买的那个本子贵一点儿。
column2: Bǐ wǒmen yìqǐ mǎi de nàge běnzi guì yìdiǎnr.
column3: A bit more expensive than the one we bought together.

column1: 这么漂亮的本子，不可能贵一点儿吧？
column2: Zhème piàoliang de běnzi, bù kěnéng guì yìdiǎnr ba?
column3: Such a pretty notebook can't be only a bit more expensive, right?

column1: 我是上网买的，真没那么贵。我买了两个，送你一个。

column3: I bought it online—it's really not that expensive. I bought two; here's one for you.

column1: 谢谢！那我送给你什么呢？
column2: Xièxie! Nà wǒ sòng gěi nǐ shénme ne?
column3: Thanks! Then what should I give you?

column1: 咖啡杯吧，我最喜欢喝咖啡了。
column2: Kāfēi bēi ba, wǒ zuì xǐhuan hē kāfēi le.
column3: A coffee mug—I love coffee most.

column1: 好，那样我们就都有新年礼物了！
column2: Hǎo, nàyàng wǒmen jiù dōu yǒu xīnnián lǐwù le!
column3: Great—then we'll both have New Year gifts!

column1: 新年就要到了，安妮送给我一个新本子。她告诉我是在网上买的，比我的本子贵一点儿。我们班同学也送了王老师漂亮的花，希望她高高兴兴地过个新年。
column2: Xīnnián jiù yào dào le, Ānnī sòng gěi wǒ yí ge xīn běnzi. Tā gàosu wǒ shì zài wǎng shàng mǎi de, bǐ wǒ de běnzi guì yìdiǎnr. Wǒmen bān tóngxué yě sòng le Wáng lǎoshī piàoliang de huā, xīwàng tā gāogāoxìngxìng de guò ge xīnnián.
column3: The New Year is almost here, and Annie gave me a new notebook. She told me she bought it online and it's a bit pricier than mine. Our class also gave Teacher Wang beautiful flowers, hoping she'll have a happy New Year.

column1: 王老师，你家楼下站着一个人。
column2: Wáng lǎoshī, nǐ jiā lóuxià zhànzhe yí ge rén.
column3: Teacher Wang, there's someone standing downstairs at your place.

column1: 我家楼下？我看看。
column2: Wǒ jiā lóuxià? Wǒ kànkan.
column3: Downstairs at my place? Let me look.

column1: 那个人穿着黑色的裤子，手里还拿着一个黑色的包。

column3: That person is wearing black pants and holding a black bag.

column1: 我看见那个人了，他是我男朋友。
column2: Wǒ kànjiàn nàge rén le, tā shì wǒ nánpéngyou.
column3: I see him—that's my boyfriend.

column1: 那我们快过去吧。
column2: Nà wǒmen kuài guòqu ba.
column3: Then let's hurry over.

column1: 同乐，真是你啊！上次打电话，你说有时间过来看我，没想到这么快就来了！
column2: Tónglè, zhēn shì nǐ a! Shàng cì dǎ diànhuà, nǐ shuō yǒu shíjiān guòlai kàn wǒ, méi xiǎngdào zhème kuài jiù lái le!
column3: Tongle, it's really you! Last time on the phone you said you'd come see me when you had time—I didn't expect you so soon!

column1: 就要过年了，你一个人在这儿多没意思啊，所以我就早早过来了。
column2: Jiù yào guònián le, nǐ yí ge rén zài zhèr duō méi yìsi a, suǒyǐ wǒ jiù zǎozǎo guòlai le.
column3: New Year's almost here, and being here alone is no fun, so I came over early.

column1: 你能来，我太高兴了！
column2: Nǐ néng lái, wǒ tài gāoxìng le!
column3: I'm so glad you could come!

column1: 一飞，你旁边这位是？
column2: Yīfēi, nǐ pángbiān zhè wèi shì?
column3: Yifei, who's this next to you?

column1: 同乐，这是李文，他在我们学校学医。李文，这是我男朋友杨同乐。
column2: Tónglè, zhè shì Lǐ Wén, tā zài wǒmen xuéxiào xué yī. Lǐ Wén, zhè shì wǒ nánpéngyou Yáng Tónglè.
column3: Tongle, this is Li Wen—he studies medicine at our school. Li Wen, this is my boyfriend Yang Tongle.

column1: 李文，很高兴认识你！
column2: Lǐ Wén, hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ!
column3: Li Wen, nice to meet you!

column1: 认识你我也很高兴！我家就在前面那个楼，有时间来玩。
column2: Rènshi nǐ wǒ yě hěn gāoxìng! Wǒ jiā jiù zài qiánmiàn nàge lóu, yǒu shíjiān lái wán.
column3: Nice to meet you too! I live in that building up ahead—come by when you have time.

column1: 一飞，你住的房子真不错，很大，离学校也不远。
column2: Yīfēi, nǐ zhù de fángzi zhēn búcuò, hěn dà, lí xuéxiào yě bù yuǎn.
column3: Yifei, your place is really nice—big, and not far from school either.

column1: 是啊！我楼下还住着一家中国人，他们人很好。
column2: Shì a! Wǒ lóuxià hái zhùzhe yì jiā Zhōngguórén, tāmen rén hěn hǎo.
column3: Yeah! A Chinese family lives downstairs from me—they're very nice.

column1: 这样你有事情就可以找他们帮忙。
column2: Zhèyàng nǐ yǒu shìqing jiù kěyǐ zhǎo tāmen bāngmáng.
column3: That way you can ask them for help if anything comes up.

column1: 对，我也帮他们家的小孩儿学中文。
column2: Duì, wǒ yě bāng tāmen jiā de xiǎoháir xué Zhōngwén.
column3: Right, and I also help their kid learn Chinese.

column1: 我记得你跟我说过，是个女孩儿，学得也很好。
column2: Wǒ jìde nǐ gēn wǒ shuōguo, shì ge nǚháir, xué de yě hěn hǎo.
column3: I remember you told me—she's a girl, and she learns well.

column1: 没错，她经常跑上来找我玩。
column2: Méicuò, tā jīngcháng pǎo shànglai zhǎo wǒ wán.
column3: That's right—she often runs up to hang out with me.

column1: 你问问他们什么时候有时间，我请他们吃个饭。
column2: Nǐ wènwen tāmen shénme shíhou yǒu shíjiān, wǒ qǐng tāmen chī ge fàn.
column3: Ask them when they're free—I'd like to treat them to a meal.

column1: 我男朋友姓杨，叫杨同乐。他高个子、大眼睛，唱歌唱得很好，跳舞跳得也不错。他和我姐姐一起工作，是姐姐介绍我们认识的。他告诉我，从见到我的第一天开始，他就喜欢上我了。
column2: Wǒ nánpéngyou xìng Yáng, jiào Yáng Tónglè. Tā gāo gèzi, dà yǎnjing, chànggē chàng de hěn hǎo, tiàowǔ tiào de yě búcuò. Tā hé wǒ jiějie yìqǐ gōngzuò, shì jiějie jièshào wǒmen rènshi de. Tā gàosu wǒ, cóng jiàndào wǒ de dì-yī tiān kāishǐ, tā jiù xǐhuan shàng wǒ le.
column3: My boyfriend's surname is Yang; his name is Yang Tongle. He's tall with big eyes, sings very well, and dances pretty well too. He works with my sister, and she introduced us. He told me that from the very first day he saw me, he fell for me.

column1: 考试就要开始了，请大家写上姓名，写好后就可以做题了。
column2: Kǎoshì jiù yào kāishǐ le, qǐng dàjiā xiě shàng xìngmíng, xiě hǎo hòu jiù kěyǐ zuò tí le.
column3: The exam is about to start—please write your name, and once you've done that you can start the questions.

column1: 老师，我做完了。
column2: Lǎoshī, wǒ zuòwán le.
column3: Teacher, I'm finished.

column1: 老师，我也做完了。
column2: Lǎoshī, wǒ yě zuòwán le.
column3: Teacher, I'm done too.

column1: ……对了，你们考完试想做什么？
column2: …… Duì le, nǐmen kǎo wán shì xiǎng zuò shénme?
column3: …By the way, what do you want to do after the exam?

column1: 我很想去中国，虽然去过一次，但是很想再去一次。
column2: Wǒ hěn xiǎng qù Zhōngguó, suīrán qùguo yí cì, dànshì hěn xiǎng zài qù yí cì.
column3: I really want to go to China—though I've been once, I'd love to go again.

column1: 不错，到中国后你就可以经常说中文了。
column2: Búcuò, dào Zhōngguó hòu nǐ jiù kěyǐ jīngcháng shuō Zhōngwén le.
column3: Nice—once in China you'll get to speak Chinese often.

column1: 考完试了，我现在可以出国旅游了。
column2: Kǎo wán shì le, wǒ xiànzài kěyǐ chū guó lǚyóu le.
column3: The exams are over—now I can travel abroad.

column1: 你要去哪儿？
column2: Nǐ yào qù nǎr?
column3: Where are you going?

column1: 我要再去一次北京。
column2: Wǒ yào zài qù yí cì Běijīng.
column3: I'm going to Beijing again.

column1: 为什么还去北京？
column2: Wèishénme hái qù Běijīng?
column3: Why Beijing again?

column1: 因为我想再吃一次烤鸭，再喝一次奶茶，再去北京大学看一次电影……
column2: Yīnwèi wǒ xiǎng zài chī yí cì kǎoyā, zài hē yí cì nǎichá, zài qù Běijīng Dàxué kàn yí cì diànyǐng……

column2: Zhèlǐ de fàncài yòu piányi yòu hǎochī, wǒmen jīngcháng lái, fúwùyuán dōu jìzhu wǒmen ài chī de cài le.
column3: The food here is cheap and tasty; we come often, and the waiters even remember our favorite dishes.

column1: 王姐，您经常来吃饭，今天送您一些水果，请慢用。
column2: Wáng jiě, nín jīngcháng lái chī fàn, jīntiān sòng nín yìxiē shuǐguǒ, qǐng màn yòng.
column3: Sister Wang, you dine here often—today some fruit is on the house, please enjoy.

column1: 这个鸡肉饭太好吃了，我要再来吃一次。
column2: Zhège jīròu fàn tài hǎochī le, wǒ yào zài lái chī yí cì.
column3: This chicken rice is so delicious—I want to come eat it again.

column1: 你可以拿走这张菜单，看看下次还吃点儿什么。
column2: Nǐ kěyǐ ná zǒu zhè zhāng càidān, kànkan xià cì hái chī diǎnr shénme.
column3: You can take this menu and see what else to eat next time.

column1: 不用拿菜单，在手机上就能看到，也可以选好了让他们给你送。
column2: Bú yòng ná càidān, zài shǒujī shàng jiù néng kàndào, yě kěyǐ xuǎn hǎo le ràng tāmen gěi nǐ sòng.
column3: No need to take the menu—you can see it on your phone, and you can even order and have it delivered.

column1: 他们家还能送外卖？
column2: Tāmen jiā hái néng sòng wàimài?
column3: They do takeout delivery too?

column1: 对，现在很多饭馆都能送外卖，想吃什么就点什么。
column2: Duì, xiànzài hěn duō fànguǎn dōu néng sòng wàimài, xiǎng chī shénme jiù diǎn shénme.
column3: Yes, many restaurants deliver now—order whatever you feel like eating.

column1: 那真是太方便了！
column2: Nà zhēn shì tài fāngbiàn le!
column3: That's really convenient!

column1: 这些年在国外，我很少自己做饭。早饭就吃一个面包，有时候吃一块蛋糕，再喝一杯咖啡。午饭和晚饭也都在外面吃。快要考试的时候又忙又累，没时间出去吃，家里又什么吃的都没有，我可能好几天只吃方便面。现在回到中国了，每天能吃到妈妈做的饭，我真是太高兴了！有时候妈妈只做几个简单的菜，我也非常爱吃，因为什么都没有妈妈做的饭好吃。
column2: Zhèxiē nián zài guówài, wǒ hěn shǎo zìjǐ zuò fàn. Zǎofàn jiù chī yí ge miànbāo, yǒushíhou chī yí kuài dàngāo, zài hē yì bēi kāfēi. Wǔfàn hé wǎnfàn yě dōu zài wàimiàn chī. Kuài yào kǎoshì de shíhou yòu máng yòu lèi, méi shíjiān chūqu chī, jiā li yòu shénme chī de dōu méiyǒu, wǒ kěnéng hǎo jǐ tiān zhǐ chī fāngbiànmiàn. Xiànzài huí dào Zhōngguó le, měi tiān néng chī dào māma zuò de fàn, wǒ zhēn shì tài gāoxìng le! Yǒushíhou māma zhǐ zuò jǐ ge jiǎndān de cài, wǒ yě fēicháng ài chī, yīnwèi shénme dōu méiyǒu māma zuò de fàn hǎochī.
column3: These years abroad, I rarely cooked for myself. For breakfast I'd just have a piece of bread, sometimes a slice of cake, and a cup of coffee. Lunch and dinner were also eaten out. Around exam time I was busy and tired with no time to go out to eat, and there was nothing to eat at home, so I might eat only instant noodles for several days. Now that I'm back in China and can eat Mom's cooking every day, I'm really happy! Sometimes Mom makes just a few simple dishes, and I love them too, because nothing is as good as Mom's cooking.

column1: 小雪的初中离家有点儿远，咱们换一个近点儿的房子吧。
column2: Xiǎoxuě de chūzhōng lí jiā yǒudiǎnr yuǎn, zánmen huàn yí ge jìn diǎnr de fángzi ba.
column3: Xiaoxue's middle school is a bit far from home—let's move to a place that's closer.

column1: 好啊，我上网看看。你觉得这个小区怎么样？
column2: Hǎo a, wǒ shàngwǎng kànkan. Nǐ juéde zhège xiǎoqū zěnmeyàng?
column3: Sure, I'll look online. What do you think of this residential complex?

column1: 环境挺好的，离地铁站还不远。
column2: Huánjìng tǐng hǎo de, lí dìtiězhàn hái bù yuǎn.
column3: The environment's quite nice, and it's not far from the subway station.

column1: 房子里面也不错，空调和洗衣机都是新的。
column2: Fángzi lǐmiàn yě búcuò, kōngtiáo hé xǐyījī dōu shì xīn de.
column3: The inside is nice too—the air conditioner and washing machine are both new.

column1: 是不错，但是我不喜欢住一层。
column2: Shì búcuò, dànshì wǒ bù xǐhuan zhù yī céng.
column3: It is nice, but I don't like living on the first floor.

column1: 这个一层带一个小花园，我觉得咱们可以去看看。
column2: Zhège yī céng dài yí ge xiǎo huāyuán, wǒ juéde zánmen kěyǐ qù kànkan.
column3: This first-floor unit comes with a little garden—I think we could go take a look.

column1: 我今天早上来的时候，灯还开着。
column2: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang lái de shíhou, dēng hái kāizhe.
column3: When I came this morning, the lights were still on.

column1: 我这几天忙坏了，可能走的时候忘关了。
column2: Wǒ zhè jǐ tiān mánghuài le, kěnéng zǒu de shíhou wàng guān le.
column3: I've been swamped these days—I probably forgot to turn them off when I left.

column1: 冰箱不能用，这些吃的东西放在哪儿？
column2: Bīngxiāng bù néng yòng, zhèxiē chī de dōngxi fàng zài nǎr?
column3: The fridge doesn't work—where should we put this food?

column1: 不可能吧？冰箱是新买的，我来看看。
column2: Bù kěnéng ba? Bīngxiāng shì xīn mǎi de, wǒ lái kànkan.
column3: No way—the fridge is newly bought. Let me take a look.

column1: 洗衣机也坏了吗？
column2: Xǐyījī yě huài le ma?
column3: Is the washing machine broken too?

column1: 没坏，但是卫生间没打扫好，还不能洗衣服。
column2: Méi huài, dànshì wèishēngjiān méi dǎsǎo hǎo, hái bù néng xǐ yīfu.
column3: It's not broken, but the bathroom isn't cleaned up yet, so we can't do laundry.

column1: 星期天我们真的能搬家吗？
column2: Xīngqītiān wǒmen zhēn de néng bānjiā ma?
column3: Can we really move on Sunday?

column1: 这个月花了不少钱。
column2: Zhège yuè huā le bù shǎo qián.
column3: We've spent quite a lot this month.

column1: 是的，我们买了很多搬家时要用的东西。
column2: Shì de, wǒmen mǎi le hěn duō bānjiā shí yào yòng de dōngxi.
column3: Yes, we bought a lot of things we'll need for the move.

column1: 咱们办张信用卡吧，花的钱可以慢慢还。听说中国银行的服务不错，办了信用卡买东西还能便宜。
column2: Zánmen bàn zhāng xìnyòngkǎ ba, huā de qián kěyǐ mànmàn huán. Tīngshuō Zhōngguó Yínháng de fúwù búcuò, bàn le xìnyòngkǎ mǎi dōngxi hái néng piányi.
column3: Let's get a credit card—we can pay off what we spend gradually. I hear Bank of China's service is good, and with a card you even get discounts when shopping.

column1: 好啊！中国银行很近，走路几分钟就能到。咱们什么时候去？
column2: Hǎo a! Zhōngguó Yínháng hěn jìn, zǒulù jǐ fēnzhōng jiù néng dào. Zánmen shénme shíhou qù?
column3: Sure! Bank of China is close—just a few minutes' walk. When should we go?

column1: 今天下午？
column2: Jīntiān xiàwǔ?
column3: This afternoon?

column1: 我下午要去医院，很晚才能回来。
column2: Wǒ xiàwǔ yào qù yīyuàn, hěn wǎn cái néng huílai.
column3: I have to go to the hospital this afternoon and won't be back until late.

column1: 那我下午自己去吧。
column2: Nà wǒ xiàwǔ zìjǐ qù ba.
column3: Then I'll go by myself this afternoon.

column1: 我觉得这个星期就能搬家。我明天去买一些纸箱，很快就能准备好。搬家那天，我想请几位朋友来帮忙，最多一天就能搬完。
column2: Wǒ juéde zhège xīngqī jiù néng bānjiā. Wǒ míngtiān qù mǎi yìxiē zhǐxiāng, hěn kuài jiù néng zhǔnbèi hǎo. Bānjiā nà tiān, wǒ xiǎng qǐng jǐ wèi péngyou lái bāngmáng, zuìduō yì tiān jiù néng bān wán.
column3: I think we can move this week. I'll buy some cardboard boxes tomorrow and be ready soon. On moving day, I'll invite a few friends to help—it'll take a day at most.

column1: 我觉得下个月才能搬家。这周开始准备，下周去打扫新家，这么多事情最少需要两个星期才能做完。搬家那天，我们应该找一家搬家公司。
column2: Wǒ juéde xià ge yuè cái néng bānjiā. Zhè zhōu kāishǐ zhǔnbèi, xià zhōu qù dǎsǎo xīn jiā, zhème duō shìqing zuìshǎo xūyào liǎng ge xīngqī cái néng zuò wán. Bānjiā nà tiān, wǒmen yīnggāi zhǎo yì jiā bānjiā gōngsī.
column3: I think we can only move next month. Prep starts this week, cleaning the new place next week—so much to do takes at least two weeks. On moving day, we should hire a moving company.

column1: 这个假期咱们去哪儿玩玩吧。
column2: Zhège jiàqī zánmen qù nǎr wánwan ba.
column3: Let's go somewhere for this holiday.

column1: 好啊，你想去哪儿，咱们就去哪儿。
column2: Hǎo a, nǐ xiǎng qù nǎr, zánmen jiù qù nǎr.
column3: Sure—wherever you want to go, we'll go.

column1: 你喜欢海，找个海边住几天，怎么样？
column2: Nǐ xǐhuan hǎi, zhǎo ge hǎibiān zhù jǐ tiān, zěnmeyàng?
column3: You like the sea—how about we stay by the seaside for a few days?

column1: 现在去海边有点儿冷。
column2: Xiànzài qù hǎibiān yǒudiǎnr lěng.
column3: It's a bit cold to go to the seaside now.

column1: 那去草原吧？草原一点儿也不冷。
column2: Nà qù cǎoyuán ba? Cǎoyuán yìdiǎnr yě bù lěng.
column3: Then how about the grasslands? The grasslands aren't cold at all.

column1: 这个主意好！我好久没骑马了。
column2: Zhège zhǔyi hǎo! Wǒ hǎojiǔ méi qí mǎ le.
column3: Great idea! I haven't ridden a horse in ages.

column1: 对，在草原上骑马、吃羊肉、看月亮，一定很有意思。
column2: Duì, zài cǎoyuán shàng qí mǎ, chī yángròu, kàn yuèliang, yídìng hěn yǒu yìsi.
column3: Right—riding horses, eating lamb, and watching the moon on the grasslands must be a lot of fun.

column1: 出去玩的机票买好了吗？
column2: Chūqu wán de jīpiào mǎihǎo le ma?
column3: Have you bought the plane tickets for the trip?

column1: 买好了。星期六上午十点一刻起飞。
column2: Mǎihǎo le. Xīngqīliù shàngwǔ shí diǎn yí kè qǐfēi.
column3: Yes. It departs Saturday morning at a quarter past ten.

column1: 宾馆也选好了吗？
column2: Bīnguǎn yě xuǎn hǎo le ma?
column3: Have you picked the hotel too?

column1: 是的，这家宾馆很特别，跟别的都不一样，一出门就能看见牛和羊！
column2: Shì de, zhè jiā bīnguǎn hěn tèbié, gēn biéde dōu bù yíyàng, yì chūmén jiù néng kànjiàn niú hé yáng!
column3: Yes—this hotel is special, unlike the others: step outside and you can see cattle and sheep!

column1: 太好了！你看看要带什么东西？
column2: Tài hǎo le! Nǐ kànkan yào dài shénme dōngxi?
column3: Great! See what we need to bring.

column1: 我们不用带太多东西，别忘了拿上新买的相机。
column2: Wǒmen bú yòng dài tài duō dōngxi, bié wàng le ná shàng xīn mǎi de xiàngjī.
column3: We don't need to bring much—just don't forget the newly bought camera.

column1: 一定不会忘带的。我现在就去准备行李。
column2: Yídìng bú huì wàng dài de. Wǒ xiànzài jiù qù zhǔnbèi xíngli.
column3: I definitely won't forget it. I'll go pack now.

column1: 欢迎你们！我是你们的司机，我姓李，叫我小李就可以。
column2: Huānyíng nǐmen! Wǒ shì nǐmen de sījī, wǒ xìng Lǐ, jiào wǒ Xiǎo Lǐ jiù kěyǐ.
column3: Welcome! I'm your driver; my surname is Li—just call me Xiao Li.

column1: 您好！不好意思，飞机晚点了，让您久等了。
column2: Nín hǎo! Bù hǎoyìsi, fēijī wǎndiǎn le, ràng nín jiǔ děng le.
column3: Hello! Sorry, the flight was delayed—thanks for waiting so long.

column1: 没关系。除了这个行李箱以外，还有别的东西吗？
column2: Méi guānxi. Chúle zhège xínglǐxiāng yǐwài, hái yǒu biéde dōngxi ma?
column3: No problem. Besides this suitcase, is there anything else?

column1: 还有一个包，我自己拿就可以。
column2: Hái yǒu yí ge bāo, wǒ zìjǐ ná jiù kěyǐ.
column3: There's also a bag—I can carry it myself.

column1: 车在一层，请跟我来。
column2: Chē zài yī céng, qǐng gēn wǒ lái.
column3: The car is on the ground floor—please follow me.

column1: 我们住的宾馆离机场远吗？
column2: Wǒmen zhù de bīnguǎn lí jīchǎng yuǎn ma?
column3: Is the hotel we're staying at far from the airport?

column1: 不远，三十分钟就能到。两位到了可以先休息休息，晚饭的时候我叫你们。
column2: Bù yuǎn, sānshí fēnzhōng jiù néng dào. Liǎng wèi dào le kěyǐ xiān xiūxi xiūxi, wǎnfàn de shíhou wǒ jiào nǐmen.
column3: Not far—about thirty minutes. Once you two arrive you can rest first; I'll call you at dinnertime.

column1: 今天是我们旅游的第一天。我们很早就起来去机场了，没想到飞机晚点了。我们到的时候，天已经黑了，但是司机小李一直在机场等我们，一点儿也没着急。他特别热情，路上给我们介绍了很多东西，还准备了水果。宾馆的房间跟我想的一样漂亮，又大又干净，我非常满意。
column2: Jīntiān shì wǒmen lǚyóu de dì-yī tiān. Wǒmen hěn zǎo jiù qǐlai qù jīchǎng le, méi xiǎngdào fēijī wǎndiǎn le. Wǒmen dào de shíhou, tiān yǐjīng hēi le, dànshì sījī Xiǎo Lǐ yìzhí zài jīchǎng děng wǒmen, yìdiǎnr yě méi zháojí. Tā tèbié rèqíng, lù shàng gěi wǒmen jièshào le hěn duō dōngxi, hái zhǔnbèi le shuǐguǒ. Bīnguǎn de fángjiān gēn wǒ xiǎng de yíyàng piàoliang, yòu dà yòu gānjìng, wǒ fēicháng mǎnyì.
column3: Today is the first day of our trip. We got up early to go to the airport, but the flight was delayed. By the time we arrived it was already dark, but our driver Xiao Li had been waiting for us at the airport the whole time without getting impatient at all. He was very warm, told us a lot along the way, and even had fruit ready. The hotel room was as pretty as I'd imagined—big and clean; I was very satisfied.

column1: 这个星期总是阴天，今天终于晴了。
column2: Zhège xīngqī zǒngshì yīntiān, jīntiān zhōngyú qíng le.
column3: It's been cloudy all week; today it's finally cleared up.

column1: 现在天气好得很！我们去爬山怎么样？
column2: Xiànzài tiānqì hǎo de hěn! Wǒmen qù pá shān zěnmeyàng?
column3: The weather is great now! How about we go hiking?

column1: 好啊！又能锻炼身体，又能照好看的照片。
column2: Hǎo a! Yòu néng duànliàn shēntǐ, yòu néng zhào hǎokàn de zhàopiàn.
column3: Sure! We can exercise and take nice photos too.

column1: 那我带点儿水和吃的，咱们现在就去？
column2: Nà wǒ dài diǎnr shuǐ hé chī de, zánmen xiànzài jiù qù?
column3: Then I'll bring some water and food—shall we go right now?

column1: 我回去穿上运动鞋，拿上大衣。要不要叫一雪姐一起来？
column2: Wǒ huíqu chuān shàng yùndòngxié, ná shàng dàyī. Yào bu yào jiào Yīxuě jiě yìqǐ lái?
column3: I'll go back and put on sneakers and grab a coat. Should we ask Sister Yixue to come along?

column1: 好主意。给她打个电话吧。
column2: Hǎo zhǔyi. Gěi tā dǎ ge diànhuà ba.
column3: Good idea. Give her a call.

column1: 这些照片是谁给您照的？张张都非常好看。
column2: Zhèxiē zhàopiàn shì shéi gěi nín zhào de? Zhāng zhāng dōu fēicháng hǎokàn.
column3: Who took these photos of you? Every single one is gorgeous.

column1: 一飞。她对拍照一直很感兴趣，经常给我照相。
column2: Yīfēi. Tā duì pāizhào yìzhí hěn gǎn xìngqù, jīngcháng gěi wǒ zhàoxiàng.
column3: Yifei. She's always been into photography and often takes pictures of me.

column1: 我喜欢您大笑的这张，看起来很漂亮。
column2: Wǒ xǐhuan nín dà xiào de zhè zhāng, kàn qǐlai hěn piàoliang.
column3: I like this one where you're laughing—you look beautiful.

column1: 我觉得这张有点儿难看，那时候我不知道她在给我照相。
column2: Wǒ juéde zhè zhāng yǒudiǎnr nánkàn, nà shíhou wǒ bù zhīdào tā zài gěi wǒ zhàoxiàng.
column3: I think this one's a bit unflattering—I didn't know she was taking my picture then.

column1: 这样的照片才好看。我也喜欢拍照，爬山的时候我给您照几张照片吧。
column2: Zhèyàng de zhàopiàn cái hǎokàn. Wǒ yě xǐhuan pāizhào, pá shān de shíhou wǒ gěi nín zhào jǐ zhāng zhàopiàn ba.
column3: That's exactly the kind of photo that looks good. I like photography too—let me take a few of you while we hike.

column1: 好，我可以比较一下你们两个谁的水平高。
column2: Hǎo, wǒ kěyǐ bǐjiào yíxià nǐmen liǎng ge shéi de shuǐpíng gāo.
column3: Sure—I can compare which of you two is the better photographer.

column1: 家月，这里挺漂亮的，咱们在这里拍照吧。
column2: Jiāyuè, zhèlǐ tǐng piàoliang de, zánmen zài zhèlǐ pāizhào ba.
column3: Jiayue, it's quite pretty here—let's take photos here.

column1: 这边没有太阳，咱们去那边吧。
column2: Zhèbiān méiyǒu tàiyáng, zánmen qù nàbiān ba.
column3: There's no sun on this side—let's go over there.

column1: 好。你觉得我站在这些树中间怎么样？
column2: Hǎo. Nǐ juéde wǒ zhàn zài zhèxiē shù zhōngjiān zěnmeyàng?
column3: Okay. How about I stand among these trees?

column1: 挺好的。等一下，后边走过去两个人。
column2: Tǐng hǎo de. Děng yíxià, hòubian zǒu guòqu liǎng ge rén.
column3: Looks good. Wait a sec—two people are walking by behind you.

column1: 我准备好了，你照的时候告诉我。

column2: Jiāyuè, wǒ shōudào le nǐ de nà fēng yóujiàn, yě kàndào le nǐ gěi wǒ zhào de zhàopiàn, zhāng zhāng dōu hěn piàoliang. Yīnyuèhuì qī diǎn duō jiéshù, nǐ tīng wán le yīnyuèhuì jiù lái wǒ jiā chī fàn, chángchang wǒ zuò de Zhōngguó cài. Nǐ juéde zěnmeyàng?
column3: Jiayue, I got your email and saw the photos you took of me—every one is beautiful. I already told Yifei that your photography is better than hers; she was quite upset, haha. I wonder if you're interested in Chinese music? I'm giving you a ticket to tomorrow afternoon's concert. It ends after seven; once it's over, come to my place for dinner and try my Chinese cooking. What do you think?

column1: 家月，咱们该买去上海的票了。你打算怎么去上海？

column3: I've never taken the high-speed train—how about we take it?

column3: No problem—there are lots of high-speed trains from Beijing to Shanghai; it's very convenient.

column3: I've heard about the high-speed train for ages—finally I get to ride it.

column3: The high-speed train is fast and comfortable—you'll definitely like it.

column3: Past the intersection ahead is the high-speed rail station.

column3: I see it. We're almost there—there's a lot of traffic on this road, be careful.

column3: Okay, you still have an hour—you shouldn't be late.

column3: I've noticed this road has a lot of cars and a lot of traffic lights.

column3: I got flustered and took the wrong way. If I hadn't, we'd have arrived twenty minutes ago.

column3: Yes—I keep these everyday things in my bag; let me get it for you.

column3: Okay—check that you've got the train tickets.

column3: No need for paper tickets—just scan your passport to get through the gate.

column3: The gate is on the second floor—we'll take the elevator up shortly.

column1: 这次放假，我去了北京，还去了上海。我是从北京南站坐高铁去的上海。我觉得坐在高铁上跟坐在家里的沙发上一样，又安静又舒服。坐累了就站一会儿，饿了就点外卖。对，你没听错，高铁上可以点外卖，只需要选择好车站和想吃的东西，到站时不用下车，服务员就会给你拿过来。现在喜欢坐高铁的人越来越多。我爸妈来中国旅游的时候，必须带他们也坐一次高铁。
column2: Zhè cì fàngjià, wǒ qù le Běijīng, hái qù le Shànghǎi. Wǒ shì cóng Běijīng Nán Zhàn zuò gāotiě qù de Shànghǎi. Wǒ juéde zuò zài gāotiě shàng gēn zuò zài jiā li de shāfā shàng yíyàng, yòu ānjìng yòu shūfu. Zuò lèi le jiù zhàn yíhuìr, è le jiù diǎn wàimài. Duì, nǐ méi tīng cuò, gāotiě shàng kěyǐ diǎn wàimài, zhǐ xūyào xuǎnzé hǎo chēzhàn hé xiǎng chī de dōngxi, dào zhàn shí bú yòng xià chē, fúwùyuán jiù huì gěi nǐ ná guòlai. Xiànzài xǐhuan zuò gāotiě de rén yuèláiyuè duō. Wǒ bà mā lái Zhōngguó lǚyóu de shíhou, bìxū dài tāmen yě zuò yí cì gāotiě.
column3: This holiday I went to Beijing and Shanghai. I took the high-speed train to Shanghai from Beijing South Station. Riding the high-speed train feels just like sitting on the sofa at home—quiet and comfortable. When you get tired of sitting, you stand for a bit; when you're hungry, you order delivery. Yes, you heard right—you can order takeout on the high-speed train: just choose the station and what you want to eat, and when you reach the station you don't get off—the attendant brings it to you. More and more people like taking the high-speed train now. When my parents come to China to travel, I must take them on the high-speed train too.

column3: We bought this bike when Xiaoxue was eight; it looks a bit old now.

column3: Yeah, she's grown taller now, and this bike is already too small.

column3: Okay, let's take Xiaoxue along so she can try it out.
