column1: 这几天我们在新家坐着看电视的时候，又发现了新问题。房子大了，电视看起来就有点儿小。这个电视是我们结婚时买的，是时候换个新电视了。今天我一直在网上选电视，没想到，现在的电视不仅便宜，而且用着非常方便，有的电视叫它一声就能开机。我看了好几个，都很满意，晚上让一雪来决定吧。
column2: Zhè jǐ tiān wǒmen zài xīn jiā zuòzhe kàn diànshì de shíhou, yòu fāxiàn le xīn wèntí. Fángzi dà le, diànshì kàn qǐlai jiù yǒudiǎnr xiǎo. Zhège diànshì shì wǒmen jiéhūn shí mǎi de, shì shíhou huàn ge xīn diànshì le. Jīntiān wǒ yìzhí zài wǎng shàng xuǎn diànshì, méi xiǎngdào, xiànzài de diànshì bùjǐn piányi, érqiě yòngzhe fēicháng fāngbiàn, yǒude diànshì jiào tā yì shēng jiù néng kāijī. Wǒ kàn le hǎojǐ ge, dōu hěn mǎnyì, wǎnshang ràng Yīxuě lái juédìng ba.
column3: These past few days, sitting and watching TV in the new place, we noticed a new problem. Now that the house is bigger, the TV looks a bit small. This TV was bought when we got married—it's time for a new one. Today I've been picking TVs online, and to my surprise, TVs now are not only cheap but also very easy to use—some turn on just by calling out to them. I looked at several I liked; I'll let Yixue decide tonight.

column3: Tianzhong, I've been seeing you at the gym a lot lately.

column3: After class I often play badminton—come join us.

column3: I'll take you to the hospital and have a doctor check you.

column3: Okay, but if you still have a fever this afternoon, you must go see a doctor.

column3: You don't look like a patient at all.

column3: You run every day and sometimes swim too—could it be too much exercise?

column2: Yīshēng yě zhème shuō, dànshì hái děi zuò wán jiǎnchá cái néng zhīdào.
column3: The doctor said so too, but we won't know until the tests are done.

column1: 别担心！听医生的话，好好休息，你的腿一定能好。

column3: Don't worry! Listen to the doctor, rest well, and your leg will surely get better.

column1: 今天我出院了。出院前，医生给我开了几种药，而且告诉了我吃药的方法。有一种药要每天睡前吃一次，其他几种每天吃三次，饭后吃。除了吃药，医生还说最重要的是多休息。我都记在心里了。回家以后一定会多注意。希望我的腿能快一点儿好。
column2: Jīntiān wǒ chūyuàn le. Chūyuàn qián, yīshēng gěi wǒ kāi le jǐ zhǒng yào, érqiě gàosu le wǒ chī yào de fāngfǎ. Yǒu yì zhǒng yào yào měi tiān shuì qián chī yí cì, qítā jǐ zhǒng měi tiān chī sān cì, fàn hòu chī. Chúle chī yào, yīshēng hái shuō zuì zhòngyào de shì duō xiūxi. Wǒ dōu jì zài xīn li le. Huí jiā yǐhòu yídìng huì duō zhùyì. Xīwàng wǒ de tuǐ néng kuài yìdiǎnr hǎo.
column3: Today I was discharged. Before I left, the doctor prescribed several kinds of medicine and told me how to take them. One kind is taken once a day before bed; the others three times a day, after meals. Besides medicine, the doctor said the most important thing is to rest more. I've kept it all in mind. After going home, I'll be sure to take good care. I hope my leg gets better soon.

column1: 我喜欢看体育比赛，最爱看的就是奥运会。奥运会是世界上影响最大的体育比赛。从1896年到2024年，每次奥运会都有非常多的运动员参加。第一位参加奥运会的中国运动员是刘长春，他1932年参加了100米和200米短跑比赛。虽然他没有得到好成绩，但是他让世界认识了中国。
column2: Wǒ xǐhuan kàn tǐyù bǐsài, zuì ài kàn de jiù shì Àoyùnhuì. Àoyùnhuì shì shìjiè shàng yǐngxiǎng zuì dà de tǐyù bǐsài. Cóng yī bā jiǔ liù nián dào èr líng èr sì nián, měi cì Àoyùnhuì dōu yǒu fēicháng duō de yùndòngyuán cānjiā. Dì-yī wèi cānjiā Àoyùnhuì de Zhōngguó yùndòngyuán shì Liú Chángchūn, tā yī jiǔ sān èr nián cānjiā le yìbǎi mǐ hé èrbǎi mǐ duǎnpǎo bǐsài. Suīrán tā méiyǒu dédào hǎo chéngjì, dànshì tā ràng shìjiè rènshi le Zhōngguó.
column3: I like watching sports, and my favorite is the Olympics. The Olympics is the most influential sporting event in the world. From 1896 to 2024, a great many athletes have competed in every Olympics. The first Chinese athlete to compete in the Olympics was Liu Changchun, who ran the 100m and 200m sprints in 1932. Although he didn't get a good result, he let the world know China.

column3: Didn't you see the email? The manager isn't back yet—the meeting won't be until next week.

column1: 那不着急了。走，吃饭去。
column2: Nà bù zháojí le. Zǒu, chī fàn qù.
column3: Then there's no rush. Come on, let's go eat.

column1: 前几天，上海的同事来北京了。一起吃饭时，他们跟我说最近有不少同事去上海工作了，问我愿意不愿意也去上海。我是这样想的：现在丈夫和孩子都在北京，刘明的工作很忙，小雪和小明也还小，我去别的城市工作就要离开他们。虽然去上海可能会有更好的机会，但是对我来说，生活也很重要，我不愿意为了工作放弃丈夫和孩子。
column2: Qián jǐ tiān, Shànghǎi de tóngshì lái Běijīng le. Yìqǐ chī fàn shí, tāmen gēn wǒ shuō zuìjìn yǒu bù shǎo tóngshì qù Shànghǎi gōngzuò le, wèn wǒ yuànyì bú yuànyì yě qù Shànghǎi. Wǒ shì zhèyàng xiǎng de: xiànzài zhàngfu hé háizi dōu zài Běijīng, Liú Míng de gōngzuò hěn máng, Xiǎoxuě hé Xiǎomíng yě hái xiǎo, wǒ qù biéde chéngshì gōngzuò jiù yào líkāi tāmen. Suīrán qù Shànghǎi kěnéng huì yǒu gèng hǎo de jīhuì, dànshì duì wǒ lái shuō, shēnghuó yě hěn zhòngyào, wǒ bú yuànyì wèile gōngzuò fàngqì zhàngfu hé háizi.
column3: A few days ago, a colleague from Shanghai came to Beijing. Over a meal, they told me quite a few colleagues had gone to work in Shanghai recently and asked whether I'd be willing to go too. Here's how I see it: my husband and children are all in Beijing now, Liu Ming's job is busy, and Xiaoxue and Xiaoming are still young—working in another city would mean leaving them. Although going to Shanghai might bring better opportunities, for me, life matters too, and I'm not willing to give up my husband and children for work.

column1: 王老师，您看，这条街上的树都开花了。
column2: Wáng lǎoshī, nín kàn, zhè tiáo jiē shàng de shù dōu kāihuā le.
column3: Teacher Wang, look—the trees on this street are all in bloom.

column1: 上周我去公园坐船了，公园里的花也开了。
column2: Shàng zhōu wǒ qù gōngyuán zuò chuán le, gōngyuán li de huā yě kāi le.
column3: Last week I went boating in the park; the flowers there are blooming too.

column1: 天气这么好，下午我也想去公园坐船。
column2: Tiānqì zhème hǎo, xiàwǔ wǒ yě xiǎng qù gōngyuán zuò chuán.
column3: The weather's so nice—this afternoon I'd like to go boating in the park too.

column1: 去吧！今天是工作日，人应该不多。
column2: Qù ba! Jīntiān shì gōngzuòrì, rén yīnggāi bù duō.
column3: Go for it! It's a weekday, so it shouldn't be crowded.

column1: 您有时间吗？我想跟您一起去。
column2: Nín yǒu shíjiān ma? Wǒ xiǎng gēn nín yìqǐ qù.
column3: Do you have time? I'd like to go with you.

column1: 我今天下午有课，不能去太远的地方。
column2: Wǒ jīntiān xiàwǔ yǒu kè, bù néng qù tài yuǎn de dìfang.
column3: I have class this afternoon, so I can't go anywhere too far.

column1: 那咱们换一天去？
column2: Nà zánmen huàn yì tiān qù?
column3: Then shall we go another day?

column1: 行。或者明天去，或者后天去，我给你打电话。
column2: Xíng. Huòzhě míngtiān qù, huòzhě hòutiān qù, wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
column3: Sure. Either tomorrow or the day after—I'll call you.

column1: 刚才还是大晴天呢，怎么突然就刮起风来了？
column2: Gāngcái háishi dà qíngtiān ne, zěnme tūrán jiù guā qǐ fēng lái le?
column3: It was sunny just now—how did the wind suddenly pick up?

column1: 好像新闻里说今天有雨。
column2: Hǎoxiàng xīnwén li shuō jīntiān yǒu yǔ.
column3: I think the news said it would rain today.

column1: 啊？我每天书包里都放着雨伞，就今天没带。
column2: À? Wǒ měi tiān shūbāo li dōu fàngzhe yǔsǎn, jiù jīntiān méi dài.
column3: Huh? I keep an umbrella in my bag every day—and today's the one day I didn't bring it.

column1: 我可以借给你，我车里有一把伞和一件雨衣。
column2: Wǒ kěyǐ jiè gěi nǐ, wǒ chē li yǒu yì bǎ sǎn hé yí jiàn yǔyī.
column3: I can lend you one—I have an umbrella and a raincoat in my car.

column1: 谢谢，希望下午天气能变好。
column2: Xièxie, xīwàng xiàwǔ tiānqì néng biàn hǎo.
column3: Thanks—I hope the weather improves this afternoon.

column1: 这个季节天气变化很快。
column2: Zhège jìjié tiānqì biànhuà hěn kuài.
column3: The weather changes fast this season.

column1: 雨已经下起来了，咱们快点儿走吧。
column2: Yǔ yǐjīng xià qǐlai le, zánmen kuài diǎnr zǒu ba.
column3: It's started raining—let's hurry.

column1: 您来这里已经一年多了，习惯了吧？
column2: Nín lái zhèlǐ yǐjīng yì nián duō le, xíguàn le ba?
column3: You've been here over a year now—you must be used to it?

column1: 别的早就习惯了，就是天气我还不太习惯。
column2: Biéde zǎo jiù xíguàn le, jiù shì tiānqì wǒ hái bú tài xíguàn.
column3: I got used to everything else long ago—it's just the weather I'm still not quite used to.

column1: 为什么？您不喜欢这里的天气吗？
column2: Wèishénme? Nín bù xǐhuan zhèlǐ de tiānqì ma?
column3: Why? Don't you like the weather here?

column1: 我觉得冬天太冷了。
column2: Wǒ juéde dōngtiān tài lěng le.
column3: I find the winters too cold.

column1: 冬天虽然冷，但是下雪的时候特别漂亮。
column2: Dōngtiān suīrán lěng, dànshì xià xuě de shíhou tèbié piàoliang.
column3: Winter is cold, but it's especially beautiful when it snows.

column1: 我也喜欢雪。北京常常下雪，但听说今年就下了一次。
column2: Wǒ yě xǐhuan xuě. Běijīng chángcháng xià xuě, dàn tīngshuō jīnnián jiù xià le yí cì.
column3: I like snow too. It often snows in Beijing, but I hear it only snowed once this year.

column1: 我没关注过北京的天气，但是新闻里说过，今年冬天很多地方雪下得都少了。
column2: Wǒ méi guānzhù guo Běijīng de tiānqì, dànshì xīnwén li shuōguo, jīnnián dōngtiān hěn duō dìfang xuě xià de dōu shǎo le.
column3: I haven't followed Beijing's weather, but the news said that this winter many places had less snowfall.

column1: 我离开北京到这里工作一年多了。这一年多住下来，我还是更喜欢北京的四季。北京的春天最舒服，天气不冷不热，夏天白天很热，但是晚上比较凉快。秋天树上的叶子都变成了红色、黄色，非常漂亮。冬天不但冷，而且风很大，我最不喜欢冬天。每个人都有自己最喜欢的季节，你最喜欢哪个季节呢？
column2: Wǒ líkāi Běijīng dào zhèlǐ gōngzuò yì nián duō le. Zhè yì nián duō zhù xiàlai, wǒ háishi gèng xǐhuan Běijīng de sìjì. Běijīng de chūntiān zuì shūfu, tiānqì bù lěng bú rè, xiàtiān báitiān hěn rè, dànshì wǎnshang bǐjiào liángkuai. Qiūtiān shù shàng de yèzi dōu biàn chéng le hóngsè, huángsè, fēicháng piàoliang. Dōngtiān búdàn lěng, érqiě fēng hěn dà, wǒ zuì bù xǐhuan dōngtiān. Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ zuì xǐhuan de jìjié, nǐ zuì xǐhuan nǎge jìjié ne?
column3: I left Beijing to work here over a year ago. After living here for over a year, I still prefer Beijing's four seasons. Beijing's spring is the most comfortable—neither cold nor hot; in summer the days are hot, but the evenings are fairly cool. In autumn the leaves turn red and yellow, very beautiful. Winter is not only cold but also very windy—I dislike winter most. Everyone has their own favorite season; which season do you like best?

column1: 今天我请客，你们想吃什么就点什么！
column2: Jīntiān wǒ qǐngkè, nǐmen xiǎng chī shénme jiù diǎn shénme!
column3: It's my treat today—order whatever you want to eat!

column1: 那我就不客气了。听说这家饭馆的鱼做得很特别？
column2: Nà wǒ jiù bú kèqi le. Tīngshuō zhè jiā fànguǎn de yú zuò de hěn tèbié?
column3: Then I won't be shy. I hear this restaurant's fish is made in a special way?

column1: 对，南方菜跟你们北方菜的做法不同。除了鱼，你们还想吃什么？
column2: Duì, nánfāng cài gēn nǐmen běifāng cài de zuòfǎ bùtóng. Chúle yú, nǐmen hái xiǎng chī shénme?
column3: Right, southern cuisine is prepared differently from your northern dishes. Besides fish, what else would you like?

column1: 我不常吃南方菜，还是你决定吧。
column2: Wǒ bù cháng chī nánfāng cài, háishi nǐ juédìng ba.
column3: I don't often eat southern food—you decide.

column1: 好，那再加一个鸡肉，一个……
column2: Hǎo, nà zài jiā yí ge jīròu, yí ge……
column3: Okay, then add a chicken dish, and one more…

column1: 咱们就三个人，别点那么多。
column2: Zánmen jiù sān ge rén, bié diǎn nàme duō.
column3: There are only three of us—don't order so much.

column1: 好，那先来这几个菜。
column2: Hǎo, nà xiān lái zhè jǐ ge cài.
column3: Okay, let's start with these few dishes.

column1: 对了，下周我儿子过生日，你们有时间的话，就来我家做客，我给你们做北京菜。
column2: Duì le, xià zhōu wǒ érzi guò shēngrì, nǐmen yǒu shíjiān de huà, jiù lái wǒ jiā zuòkè, wǒ gěi nǐmen zuò Běijīng cài.
column3: By the way, my son's birthday is next week—if you have time, come over to my place, and I'll cook you some Beijing dishes.

column1: 第一次请新邻居来做客，总是担心有什么没准备好。
column2: Dì-yī cì qǐng xīn línjū lái zuòkè, zǒngshì dānxīn yǒu shénme méi zhǔnbèi hǎo.
column3: It's the first time inviting the new neighbors over—I keep worrying something isn't ready.

column1: 放心吧，我都准备了，都已经准备好了。
column2: Fàngxīn ba, wǒ dōu zhǔnbèi le, dōu yǐjīng zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
column3: Relax—I've prepared everything; it's all ready.

column1: 我记得刚才已经把饮料拿出来了，怎么不见了？
column2: Wǒ jìde gāngcái yǐjīng bǎ yǐnliào ná chūlai le, zěnme bú jiàn le?
column3: I remember I took the drinks out just now—how come they're gone?

column1: 我把饮料和酒都放进冰箱里了，客人来了再拿出来。
column2: Wǒ bǎ yǐnliào hé jiǔ dōu fàng jìn bīngxiāng li le, kèrén lái le zài ná chūlai.
column3: I put the drinks and wine back in the fridge—I'll take them out when the guests arrive.

column1: 音乐的声音合适吗？
column2: Yīnyuè de shēngyīn héshì ma?
column3: Is the music volume okay?

column1: 你把声音开得太大了，我去关小一点儿。
column2: Nǐ bǎ shēngyīn kāi de tài dà le, wǒ qù guān xiǎo yìdiǎnr.
column3: You've got the volume too loud—I'll go turn it down a bit.

column1: 好，那我们就等客人来吧。
column2: Hǎo, nà wǒmen jiù děng kèrén lái ba.
column3: Okay, then let's wait for the guests to arrive.

column1: 谢谢你们来参加我儿子的生日晚会，希望大家今晚玩得开心。
column2: Xièxie nǐmen lái cānjiā wǒ érzi de shēngrì wǎnhuì, xīwàng dàjiā jīnwǎn wán de kāixīn.
column3: Thank you all for coming to my son's birthday party—I hope everyone has fun tonight.

column1: 小明，生日快乐！我准备了一个小礼物，希望你喜欢！
column2: Xiǎomíng, shēngrì kuàilè! Wǒ zhǔnbèi le yí ge xiǎo lǐwù, xīwàng nǐ xǐhuan!
column3: Xiaoming, happy birthday! I got you a little gift—I hope you like it!

column1: 谢谢您，我可以打开吗？
column2: Xièxie nín, wǒ kěyǐ dǎkāi ma?
column3: Thank you—may I open it?

column1: 当然可以，你妈妈说你跟姐姐一样，都喜欢画画，对吗？
column2: Dāngrán kěyǐ, nǐ māma shuō nǐ gēn jiějie yíyàng, dōu xǐhuan huà huà, duì ma?
column3: Of course. Your mom said you like drawing, just like your sister—right?

column1: 对，我想做一名画家。啊！画板和画笔，这正是我需要的。我太喜欢了。
column2: Duì, wǒ xiǎng zuò yì míng huàjiā. À! Huàbǎn hé huàbǐ, zhè zhèng shì wǒ xūyào de. Wǒ tài xǐhuan le.
column3: Yes, I want to be a painter. Oh! A drawing board and brushes—that's exactly what I need. I love it.

column1: 我去把盘子拿过来，咱们一边吃蛋糕、一边聊天儿吧。
column2: Wǒ qù bǎ pánzi ná guòlai, zánmen yìbiān chī dàngāo, yìbiān liáotiānr ba.
column3: I'll go get the plates—let's eat cake and chat.

column1: 我的新邻居是来自英国的夫妻。上周我去他们家做客了。他们做了很多好吃的，还准备了英国的红茶。那天我跟他们一边喝红茶，一边聊天儿，直到十二点多才回家。他们年轻的时候喜欢旅游，他家有一张世界地图，上面每一个红点都是他们去过的地方。后来，他们感到东方的文化很特别，就开始学习中文。今天是小明的生日，我请他们到我家玩，来看中国人的家，也尝尝中国菜。
column2: Wǒ de xīn línjū shì láizì Yīngguó de fūqī. Shàng zhōu wǒ qù tāmen jiā zuòkè le. Tāmen zuò le hěn duō hǎochī de, hái zhǔnbèi le Yīngguó de hóngchá. Nà tiān wǒ gēn tāmen yìbiān hē hóngchá, yìbiān liáotiānr, zhídào shí'èr diǎn duō cái huí jiā. Tāmen niánqīng de shíhou xǐhuan lǚyóu, tā jiā yǒu yì zhāng shìjiè dìtú, shàngmiàn měi yí ge hóng diǎn dōu shì tāmen qùguo de dìfang. Hòulái, tāmen gǎndào dōngfāng de wénhuà hěn tèbié, jiù kāishǐ xuéxí Zhōngwén. Jīntiān shì Xiǎomíng de shēngrì, wǒ qǐng tāmen dào wǒ jiā wán, lái kàn Zhōngguórén de jiā, yě chángchang Zhōngguó cài.
column3: My new neighbors are a couple from England. Last week I visited their home. They made lots of delicious food and prepared English black tea. That day I drank black tea and chatted with them until past twelve before going home. When they were young they liked to travel; they have a world map at home, and every red dot on it is a place they've been. Later, they felt Eastern culture was special and began learning Chinese. Today is Xiaoming's birthday, so I invited them to my home to play, to see a Chinese family's home and taste Chinese food.

column1: 我借的这本词典最好今天还，但是我没时间去。
column2: Wǒ jiè de zhè běn cídiǎn zuìhǎo jīntiān huán, dànshì wǒ méi shíjiān qù.
column3: This dictionary I borrowed should really be returned today, but I don't have time to go.

column1: 下午我只有两节课，可以帮你去图书馆还书。
column2: Xiàwǔ wǒ zhǐ yǒu liǎng jié kè, kěyǐ bāng nǐ qù túshūguǎn huán shū.
column3: I only have two classes this afternoon—I can return the book at the library for you.

column1: 那太谢谢了。你能再帮我借本书吗？
column2: Nà tài xièxie le. Nǐ néng zài bāng wǒ jiè běn shū ma?
column3: Thank you so much. Could you also borrow a book for me?

column1: 行，你告诉我书名。
column2: Xíng, nǐ gàosu wǒ shūmíng.
column3: Sure—tell me the title.

column1: 我把名字写在纸上吧。我去了好几次图书馆，这本书都被别人借走了。
column2: Wǒ bǎ míngzi xiě zài zhǐ shàng ba. Wǒ qù le hǎojǐ cì túshūguǎn, zhè běn shū dōu bèi biéren jiè zǒu le.
column3: I'll write the title on paper. I went to the library several times, but this book had always been borrowed by someone else.

column1: 《名人的故事》？我有这本书。明天我借给你吧。
column2: Míngrén de gùshi? Wǒ yǒu zhè běn shū. Míngtiān wǒ jiè gěi nǐ ba.
column3: Stories of Famous People? I have this book. I'll lend it to you tomorrow.

column1: 今天下课早，你一会儿做什么？
column2: Jīntiān xiàkè zǎo, nǐ yíhuìr zuò shénme?
column3: Class ended early today—what are you doing later?

column1: 我今天忙得很，要先去图书馆借书，然后去游泳。
column2: Wǒ jīntiān máng de hěn, yào xiān qù túshūguǎn jiè shū, ránhòu qù yóuyǒng.
column3: I'm really busy today—I need to borrow a book at the library first, then go swimming.

column1: 咱们一起走吧，我想去图书馆看看中文报纸。
column2: Zánmen yìqǐ zǒu ba, wǒ xiǎng qù túshūguǎn kànkan Zhōngwén bàozhǐ.
column3: Let's go together—I want to read Chinese newspapers at the library.

column1: 等等，我的校园卡不见了，没有卡进不去图书馆。
column2: Děngdeng, wǒ de xiàoyuánkǎ bú jiàn le, méiyǒu kǎ jìn bú qù túshūguǎn.
column3: Wait—my campus card is missing; without it I can't get into the library.

column1: 你想想上一次用是什么时候？
column2: Nǐ xiǎngxiang shàng yí cì yòng shì shénme shíhou?
column3: Think about when you last used it.

column1: 我忘记了，可能被我放在家里了。
column2: Wǒ wàngjì le, kěnéng bèi wǒ fàng zài jiā li le.
column3: I've forgotten—maybe I left it at home.

column1: 进不去图书馆也没关系，上网看看有没有电子书。
column2: Jìn bú qù túshūguǎn yě méi guānxi, shàngwǎng kànkan yǒu méiyǒu diànzǐshū.
column3: It's okay if you can't get into the library—check online for an e-book.

column1: 不行，我必须去，我还得帮李文还书呢。
column2: Bù xíng, wǒ bìxū qù, wǒ hái děi bāng Lǐ Wén huán shū ne.
column3: No, I have to go—I still need to return a book for Li Wen.

column1: 下周学校有晚会，你知道吗？
column2: Xià zhōu xuéxiào yǒu wǎnhuì, nǐ zhīdào ma?
column3: There's a school party next week—did you know?

column1: 知道，我和几个女生要表演一个节目。你也参加吗？
column2: Zhīdào, wǒ hé jǐ ge nǚshēng yào biǎoyǎn yí ge jiémù. Nǐ yě cānjiā ma?
column3: Yes—some other girls and I are going to perform an act. Are you taking part too?

column1: 我想唱中文歌，但是还没找到人一起表演，不知道怎么办。
column2: Wǒ xiǎng chàng Zhōngwén gē, dànshì hái méi zhǎodào rén yìqǐ biǎoyǎn, bù zhīdào zěnme bàn.
column3: I want to sing a Chinese song, but I haven't found anyone to perform with—I don't know what to do.

column1: 找不到人，你就一个人唱吧。
column2: Zhǎobudào rén, nǐ jiù yí ge rén chàng ba.
column3: If you can't find anyone, just sing solo.

column1: 一想到要在校长、老师和那么多同学面前表演，我就有些紧张。
column2: Yì xiǎngdào yào zài xiàozhǎng, lǎoshī hé nàme duō tóngxué miànqián biǎoyǎn, wǒ jiù yǒuxiē jǐnzhāng.
column3: Just thinking about performing in front of the principal, teachers, and so many classmates makes me a bit nervous.

column1: 紧张什么啊，我们都喜欢听你唱歌，你要相信自己。
column2: Jǐnzhāng shénme a, wǒmen dōu xǐhuan tīng nǐ chànggē, nǐ yào xiāngxìn zìjǐ.
column3: What's there to be nervous about? We all love hearing you sing—you have to believe in yourself.

column1: 昨天是我们学校的新年晚会，每个班级的同学都表演节目了。晚会是八点开始的，差不多十二点才结束。我一个晚上跟大家一起又唱又跳，开心极了，也累坏了。我最喜欢的节目是留学生们跳舞，最后老师和校长也被叫起来一块儿跳，特别有意思。过几天学校的网站上会有晚会的视频，我打算再看一遍。
column2: Zuótiān shì wǒmen xuéxiào de xīnnián wǎnhuì, měi ge bānjí de tóngxué dōu biǎoyǎn jiémù le. Wǎnhuì shì bā diǎn kāishǐ de, chàbuduō shí'èr diǎn cái jiéshù. Wǒ yí ge wǎnshang gēn dàjiā yìqǐ yòu chàng yòu tiào, kāixīn jí le, yě lèihuài le. Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de jiémù shì liúxuéshēngmen tiàowǔ, zuìhòu lǎoshī hé xiàozhǎng yě bèi jiào qǐlai yíkuàir tiào, tèbié yǒu yìsi. Guò jǐ tiān xuéxiào de wǎngzhàn shàng huì yǒu wǎnhuì de shìpín, wǒ dǎsuàn zài kàn yí biàn.
column3: Yesterday was our school's New Year party, and students from every class performed. The party started at eight and didn't end until nearly twelve. I sang and danced with everyone all evening—I was thrilled, and also worn out. My favorite act was the international students' dance; at the end, the teachers and principal were even pulled up to dance too, which was really fun. In a few days there'll be a video of the party on the school website, and I plan to watch it again.

column1: 您搬到蓝天小区一段时间了，觉得怎么样？
column2: Nín bān dào Lántiān Xiǎoqū yí duàn shíjiān le, juéde zěnmeyàng?
column3: You've lived in Lantian residential complex for a while now—how do you find it?

column1: 小区环境挺好的，附近买东西也很方便，过马路就是超市。
column2: Xiǎoqū huánjìng tǐng hǎo de, fùjìn mǎi dōngxi yě hěn fāngbiàn, guò mǎlù jiù shì chāoshì.
column3: The complex has a nice environment, and shopping nearby is convenient—cross the street and there's a supermarket.

column1: 平时孩子们在哪儿玩？
column2: Píngshí háizimen zài nǎr wán?
column3: Where do the children usually play?

column1: 小区里有很多树，孩子们放学后就在树下做游戏。你想买房子吗？
column2: Xiǎoqū li yǒu hěn duō shù, háizimen fàngxué hòu jiù zài shù xià zuò yóuxì. Nǐ xiǎng mǎi fángzi ma?
column3: There are lots of trees in the complex, and the kids play games under them after school. Are you thinking of buying a place?

column1: 是。我想买一个大房子，让我爸妈过来跟我一起住。
column2: Shì. Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí ge dà fángzi, ràng wǒ bà mā guòlai gēn wǒ yìqǐ zhù.
column3: Yes. I want to buy a big house so my parents can come live with me.

column1: 蓝天小区的老人挺多的，这几年小区根据他们的需要，有了很多变化。
column2: Lántiān Xiǎoqū de lǎorén tǐng duō de, zhè jǐ nián xiǎoqū gēnjù tāmen de xūyào, yǒu le hěn duō biànhuà.
column3: Lantian complex has quite a few elderly people, and in recent years it's made many changes to meet their needs.

column1: 真不错！过几天我去蓝天小区看看。
column2: Zhēn búcuò! Guò jǐ tiān wǒ qù Lántiān Xiǎoqū kànkan.
column3: That's great! In a few days I'll go take a look at Lantian complex.

column1: 假期我想去南京旅游，但是我不太了解那里。
column2: Jiàqī wǒ xiǎng qù Nánjīng lǚyóu, dànshì wǒ bú tài liǎojiě nàli.
column3: I want to travel to Nanjing over the holiday, but I don't know much about it.

column1: 我虽然不是南京人，可是我是在南京上的大学，可以说是半个南京人。
column2: Wǒ suīrán bú shì Nánjīng rén, kěshì wǒ shì zài Nánjīng shàng de dàxué, kěyǐ shuō shì bàn ge Nánjīng rén.
column3: Although I'm not from Nanjing, I went to university there, so you could say I'm half a Nanjing local.

column1: 太好了！你快给我介绍一下南京吧。
column2: Tài hǎo le! Nǐ kuài gěi wǒ jièshào yíxià Nánjīng ba.
column3: Great! Tell me about Nanjing.

column1: 南京有两千年以上的历史，有老城、老街，还有很多有名的景点，每年去旅游的游客特别多。
column2: Nánjīng yǒu liǎngqiān nián yǐshàng de lìshǐ, yǒu lǎo chéng, lǎo jiē, háiyǒu hěn duō yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn, měi nián qù lǚyóu de yóukè tèbié duō.
column3: Nanjing has over two thousand years of history, with an old city, old streets, and many famous attractions—huge numbers of tourists visit every year.

column1: 除了这些以外，你再告诉我一些外地人不知道的地方。
column2: Chúle zhèxiē yǐwài, nǐ zài gàosu wǒ yìxiē wàidì rén bù zhīdào de dìfang.
column3: Besides these, tell me about some places that out-of-towners don't know about.

column1: 那太多了，我得一点儿一点儿给您讲。
column2: Nà tài duō le, wǒ děi yìdiǎnr yìdiǎnr gěi nín jiǎng.
column3: There are so many—I'll have to tell you bit by bit.

column1: 行，下班后我请你吃晚饭，咱们边吃边聊。
column2: Xíng, xiàbān hòu wǒ qǐng nǐ chī wǎnfàn, zánmen biān chī biān liáo.
column3: Sure—after work I'll treat you to dinner, and we'll talk while we eat.

column1: 小明，中国有一条大河，它的名字跟颜色有关系，你知道是什么河吗？
column2: Xiǎomíng, Zhōngguó yǒu yì tiáo dà hé, tā de míngzi gēn yánsè yǒu guānxi, nǐ zhīdào shì shénme hé ma?
column3: Xiaoming, China has a great river whose name is related to a color—do you know which river it is?

column1: 我知道，是黄河！
column2: Wǒ zhīdào, shì Huáng Hé!
column3: I know—it's the Yellow River!

column1: 你说对了。我再问问你，你知道它为什么叫黄河吗？
column2: Nǐ shuō duì le. Wǒ zài wènwen nǐ, nǐ zhīdào tā wèishénme jiào Huáng Hé ma?
column3: You're right. Let me ask you another: do you know why it's called the Yellow River?

column1: 因为河水看起来是黄色的，所以叫这个名字。黄河是中国最长的河吗？
column2: Yīnwèi héshuǐ kàn qǐlai shì huángsè de, suǒyǐ jiào zhège míngzi. Huáng Hé shì Zhōngguó zuì cháng de hé ma?
column3: Because the water looks yellow, so it got this name. Is the Yellow River China's longest river?

column1: 不是。黄河虽然不是最长的河，可是在历史上很重要。
column2: Bú shì. Huáng Hé suīrán bú shì zuì cháng de hé, kěshì zài lìshǐ shàng hěn zhòngyào.
column3: No. Although the Yellow River isn't the longest, it's very important in history.

column1: 这个我知道。很久以前，很多中国人都住在黄河边上。
column2: Zhège wǒ zhīdào. Hěn jiǔ yǐqián, hěn duō Zhōngguórén dōu zhù zài Huáng Hé biān shàng.
column3: I know this. Long ago, many Chinese people lived along the Yellow River.

column1: 对。在我们中国人看来，黄河像妈妈一样，养了我们几千年。
column2: Duì. Zài wǒmen Zhōngguórén kànlái, Huáng Hé xiàng māma yíyàng, yǎng le wǒmen jǐqiān nián.
column3: Right. To us Chinese, the Yellow River is like a mother—it has nourished us for thousands of years.

column1: 我小时候住在北京的西北边，有一条非常有名的河经过那里。我家就住在河边。那里有高高的大树和绿绿的草地。春天，河边的花都开了，看起来特别漂亮。还记得小时候，一到夏天我就去河里游泳。长大以后，遇到什么不开心的事情，我就去河边的树下坐着，听听鸟叫，看看河水，跟遇见的朋友聊聊天儿，难过的事情不一会儿就忘了。那是我最喜欢的地方。
column2: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou zhù zài Běijīng de xīběibian, yǒu yì tiáo fēicháng yǒumíng de hé jīngguò nàli. Wǒ jiā jiù zhù zài hé biān. Nàli yǒu gāogāo de dà shù hé lǜlǜ de cǎodì. Chūntiān, hé biān de huā dōu kāi le, kàn qǐlai tèbié piàoliang. Hái jìde xiǎoshíhou, yí dào xiàtiān wǒ jiù qù hé li yóuyǒng. Zhǎng dà yǐhòu, yùdào shénme bù kāixīn de shìqing, wǒ jiù qù hé biān de shù xià zuòzhe, tīngting niǎo jiào, kànkan héshuǐ, gēn yùjiàn de péngyou liáoliao tiānr, nánguò de shìqing bù yíhuìr jiù wàng le. Nà shì wǒ zuì xǐhuan de dìfang.
column3: When I was little I lived in the northwest of Beijing, where a very famous river passed through. My home was right by the river. There were tall trees and green grass. In spring, the flowers by the river bloomed and looked especially beautiful. I still remember that as a child, come summer, I'd go swimming in the river. As I grew up, whenever I ran into something upsetting, I'd go sit under the trees by the river, listen to the birds, watch the water, and chat with friends I met—my troubles would be forgotten in no time. That was my favorite place.

column1: 这只小猫你们养了多久了？
column2: Zhè zhī xiǎo māo nǐmen yǎng le duōjiǔ le?
column3: How long have you had this kitten?

column1: 已经一年多了。第一天看见它的时候，它又脏又小。
column2: Yǐjīng yì nián duō le. Dì-yī tiān kànjiàn tā de shíhou, tā yòu zāng yòu xiǎo.
column3: Over a year now. The first day I saw it, it was dirty and tiny.

column1: 现在它变得又干净又漂亮了。
column2: Xiànzài tā biàn de yòu gānjìng yòu piàoliang le.
column3: Now it's become clean and pretty.

column1: 是啊。它还特别可爱，一会儿在你脚边睡觉，一会儿在你身上爬。
column2: Shì a. Tā hái tèbié kě'ài, yíhuìr zài nǐ jiǎo biān shuìjiào, yíhuìr zài nǐ shēn shàng pá.
column3: Yeah. It's really cute too—one moment sleeping by your feet, the next climbing on you.

column1: 你们把它照顾得真好。
column2: Nǐmen bǎ tā zhàogù de zhēn hǎo.
column3: You've taken really good care of it.

column1: 它就好像我们的孩子，我们照顾它，它也认得我们了。
column2: Tā jiù hǎoxiàng wǒmen de háizi, wǒmen zhàogù tā, tā yě rènde wǒmen le.
column3: It's just like our child—we take care of it, and it knows us now.

column1: 妈妈，我们家也养一只小猫吧。
column2: Māma, wǒmen jiā yě yǎng yì zhī xiǎo māo ba.
column3: Mom, let's get a kitten too.

column1: 咱们没时间照顾，还是别养了，我周末带你们去北京动物园看动物吧。
column2: Zánmen méi shíjiān zhàogù, háishi bié yǎng le, wǒ zhōumò dài nǐmen qù Běijīng dòngwùyuán kàn dòngwù ba.
column3: We don't have time to look after one—let's not. I'll take you to the Beijing Zoo to see animals this weekend.

column1: 妈妈，大熊猫这个名字很奇怪，它们跟猫有什么关系？
column2: Māma, dà xióngmāo zhège míngzi hěn qíguài, tāmen gēn māo yǒu shénme guānxi?
column3: Mom, the name "giant panda" is strange—what do they have to do with cats?

column1: 这个问题问得好。它们跟猫没什么关系，其实应该叫大猫熊。
column2: Zhège wèntí wèn de hǎo. Tāmen gēn māo méi shénme guānxi, qíshí yīnggāi jiào dà māoxióng.
column3: Good question. They have little to do with cats—actually they should be called "big cat-bears."

column1: 大熊猫为什么只吃竹子不吃肉？
column2: Dà xióngmāo wèishénme zhǐ chī zhúzi bù chī ròu?
column3: Why do giant pandas only eat bamboo and not meat?

column1: 它们跟人一样，也可以吃肉，但是对肉不感兴趣。
column2: Tāmen gēn rén yíyàng, yě kěyǐ chī ròu, dànshì duì ròu bù gǎn xìngqù.
column3: Like humans, they can eat meat too, but they're just not interested in it.

column1: 大熊猫为什么是中国的国宝？
column2: Dà xióngmāo wèishénme shì Zhōngguó de guóbǎo?
column3: Why are giant pandas China's national treasure?

column1: 全世界只有中国有野生大熊猫，中国是大熊猫的家。
column2: Quán shìjiè zhǐyǒu Zhōngguó yǒu yěshēng dà xióngmāo, Zhōngguó shì dà xióngmāo de jiā.
column3: China is the only place in the world with wild giant pandas—China is their home.

column1: 我听说有的熊猫出国了，他们去哪儿了？
column2: Wǒ tīngshuō yǒude xióngmāo chū guó le, tāmen qù nǎr le?
column3: I heard some pandas have gone abroad—where did they go?

column1: 关于这个问题，我得慢慢给你讲。
column2: Guānyú zhège wèntí, wǒ děi mànmàn gěi nǐ jiǎng.
column3: As for that, I'll have to explain it to you slowly.

column1: 弟弟，你真是“十万个为什么”。
column2: Dìdi, nǐ zhēn shì "shí wàn ge wèishénme".
column3: Little brother, you really are a "hundred thousand whys."

column1: 这只大熊猫一会儿爬上去，一会儿跳下来，可爱极了！
column2: Zhè zhī dà xióngmāo yíhuìr pá shàngqu, yíhuìr tiào xiàlai, kě'ài jí le!
column3: This giant panda climbs up one moment and jumps down the next—it's so cute!

column1: 它好像还没吃饱，站起来张着嘴找吃的呢。
column2: Tā hǎoxiàng hái méi chībǎo, zhàn qǐlai zhāngzhe zuǐ zhǎo chī de ne.
column3: It doesn't seem full yet—it's standing up with its mouth open, looking for food.

column1: 它身边那只熊猫半天没动，是不是在睡觉呢？
column2: Tā shēnbiān nà zhī xióngmāo bàntiān méi dòng, shì bu shì zài shuìjiào ne?
column3: The panda next to it hasn't moved for a while—is it sleeping?

column1: 我看不见它的脸，可能是吧。一般来说，熊猫每天要睡很多次觉。
column2: Wǒ kànbujiàn tā de liǎn, kěnéng shì ba. Yìbān lái shuō, xióngmāo měi tiān yào shuì hěn duō cì jiào.
column3: I can't see its face—probably. Generally, pandas sleep many times a day.

column1: 对，除了睡觉以外，很多时间都在吃东西。
column2: Duì, chúle shuìjiào yǐwài, hěn duō shíjiān dōu zài chī dōngxi.
column3: Right—apart from sleeping, they spend a lot of time eating.

column1: 大熊猫的生活真舒服啊！
column2: Dà xióngmāo de shēnghuó zhēn shūfu a!
column3: Giant pandas really have a comfortable life!

column1: 妈妈，您帮我和这两只大熊猫照一张照片吧。
column2: Māma, nín bāng wǒ hé zhè liǎng zhī dà xióngmāo zhào yì zhāng zhàopiàn ba.
column3: Mom, take a photo of me with these two giant pandas.

column1: 今天我带小雪和小明去动物园玩了。北京动物园是中国很有名的动物园，里面有非常多的动物，当然，大人和孩子最喜爱的还是大熊猫。每天有很多游客去熊猫馆，他们带着相机去给可爱的大熊猫拍照。动物园早上七点半开门，晚上七点关门，冬天比夏天游客少，所以也比平时早关门一个小时。如果第一次来北京旅游，跟家人一起去北京动物园是个不错的选择。
column2: Jīntiān wǒ dài Xiǎoxuě hé Xiǎomíng qù dòngwùyuán wán le. Běijīng dòngwùyuán shì Zhōngguó hěn yǒumíng de dòngwùyuán, lǐmiàn yǒu fēicháng duō de dòngwù, dāngrán, dàren hé háizi zuì xǐ'ài de háishi dà xióngmāo. Měi tiān yǒu hěn duō yóukè qù xióngmāo guǎn, tāmen dàizhe xiàngjī qù gěi kě'ài de dà xióngmāo pāizhào. Dòngwùyuán zǎoshang qī diǎn bàn kāimén, wǎnshang qī diǎn guānmén, dōngtiān bǐ xiàtiān yóukè shǎo, suǒyǐ yě bǐ píngshí zǎo guānmén yí ge xiǎoshí. Rúguǒ dì-yī cì lái Běijīng lǚyóu, gēn jiārén yìqǐ qù Běijīng dòngwùyuán shì ge búcuò de xuǎnzé.
column3: Today I took Xiaoxue and Xiaoming to the zoo. The Beijing Zoo is a very famous zoo in China with a huge variety of animals; of course, what adults and children love most is the giant panda. Every day many visitors go to the panda house, bringing cameras to photograph the adorable pandas. The zoo opens at 7:30 a.m. and closes at 7 p.m.; there are fewer visitors in winter than in summer, so it also closes an hour earlier than usual. If it's your first time traveling to Beijing, going to the Beijing Zoo with family is a good choice.

column1: 别再向前走了，李老师的办公室已经到了。
column2: Bié zài xiàng qián zǒu le, Lǐ lǎoshī de bàngōngshì yǐjīng dào le.
column3: Don't go any further—we've reached Teacher Li's office.

column1: 你进去吧，我在楼梯那儿等你。我害怕见李老师。
column2: Nǐ jìnqu ba, wǒ zài lóutī nàr děng nǐ. Wǒ hàipà jiàn Lǐ lǎoshī.
column3: You go in—I'll wait for you by the stairs. I'm afraid to see Teacher Li.

column1: 怎么回事？
column2: Zěnme huí shì?
column3: What's the matter?

column1: 最近我做错了好几件事，我怕李老师生气。
column2: Zuìjìn wǒ zuòcuò le hǎojǐ jiàn shì, wǒ pà Lǐ lǎoshī shēngqì.
column3: I've done several things wrong lately, and I'm afraid Teacher Li will be angry.

column1: 你想多了，做错事情是很常见的。
column2: Nǐ xiǎng duō le, zuòcuò shìqing shì hěn chángjiàn de.
column3: You're overthinking it—making mistakes is very common.

column1: 我把简单的事情做错了，李老师一定觉得我不认真。
column2: Wǒ bǎ jiǎndān de shìqing zuòcuò le, Lǐ lǎoshī yídìng juéde wǒ bú rènzhēn.
column3: I got simple things wrong—Teacher Li must think I'm not being careful.

column1: 有的人虽然很聪明，但是会在简单的事情中出错，因为他们认为事情简单，就不会认真去做了。
column2: Yǒude rén suīrán hěn cōngming, dànshì huì zài jiǎndān de shìqing zhōng chūcuò, yīnwèi tāmen rènwéi shìqing jiǎndān, jiù bú huì rènzhēn qù zuò le.
column3: Some people, though smart, make mistakes on simple things, because they think the task is easy and stop doing it carefully.

column1: 你说的就是我，以后我要多向认真的人学习。
column2: Nǐ shuō de jiù shì wǒ, yǐhòu wǒ yào duō xiàng rènzhēn de rén xuéxí.
column3: That's exactly me—from now on I'll learn more from people who are careful.

column1: 太阳从西边出来了？这几天怎么总是在图书馆看见你？

column3: Did the sun rise in the west? How come I keep seeing you at the library these days?

column2: Zhè yǒu shénme qíguài de? Wǒ yào lái xuéxí de.
column3: What's so strange about it? I came to study.

column2: Nǐ zěnme hái lái túshūguǎn xuéxí? Tóngxuémen dōu zài dàochù zhǎo gōngzuò ne.
column3: Why are you still coming to the library to study? Everyone else is out job-hunting.

column1: 我不想现在就工作，还想继续学习，我爸妈也同意。可我还没想好学什么，所以来图书馆看看。
column2: Wǒ bù xiǎng xiànzài jiù gōngzuò, hái xiǎng jìxù xuéxí, wǒ bà mā yě tóngyì. Kě wǒ hái méi xiǎnghǎo xué shénme, suǒyǐ lái túshūguǎn kànkan.
column3: I don't want to work yet—I want to keep studying, and my parents agree. But I haven't decided what to study, so I came to the library to look around.

column1: 你不是喜欢玩电脑吗？你可以去看看跟电脑有关的书。
column2: Nǐ bú shì xǐhuan wán diànnǎo ma? Nǐ kěyǐ qù kànkan gēn diànnǎo yǒuguān de shū.
column3: Don't you like computers? You could look at some books related to computers.

column1: 你说得对，我记得那个屋子里有些跟电脑有关的书，我去找找。
column2: Nǐ shuō de duì, wǒ jìde nàge wūzi li yǒuxiē gēn diànnǎo yǒuguān de shū, wǒ qù zhǎozhao.
column3: You're right—I remember there are some computer-related books in that room; I'll go look.

column2: Tiānzhōng, nǐ de shǒujī zěnme guānjī le?
column3: Tianzhong, why is your phone turned off?

column2: Wǒ de shǒujī méi diàn le. Nǐ zhǎo wǒ yǒu shì ma?
column3: My phone died. Did you need me for something?

column2: Qiántiān wǒ kànjiàn Jiāyuè le, tā gàosu wǒ nǐ dǎsuàn jìxù liúxué?
column3: I saw Jiayue the day before yesterday—she told me you're planning to keep studying abroad?

column1: 是，可是我还没想好学什么，更没想好去哪个国家。
column2: Shì, kěshì wǒ hái méi xiǎnghǎo xué shénme, gèng méi xiǎnghǎo qù nǎge guójiā.
column3: Yes, but I haven't decided what to study, let alone which country to go to.

column1: 你可以去中国学中文啊。比如可以去北京、上海这样的城市，那里有很多好大学，也有很多留学生。
column2: Nǐ kěyǐ qù Zhōngguó xué Zhōngwén a. Bǐrú kěyǐ qù Běijīng, Shànghǎi zhèyàng de chéngshì, nàli yǒu hěn duō hǎo dàxué, yě yǒu hěn duō liúxuéshēng.
column3: You could go to China to study Chinese. For example, cities like Beijing and Shanghai have many good universities and lots of international students.

column1: 好，那我上网查一查。
column2: Hǎo, nà wǒ shàngwǎng chá yi chá.
column3: Okay, I'll look it up online.

column1: 我给你介绍几个有用的网站。
column2: Wǒ gěi nǐ jièshào jǐ ge yǒuyòng de wǎngzhàn.
column3: I'll recommend a few useful websites to you.

column1: 大学生活马上就要结束了，我最近经常被问到一个问题——“你以后想做什么”，这个问题真不容易回答。我也问了几个同学，大家选择的方向都不同。有的想继续在学校学习，有的打算出国留学，还有的决定先找工作。我认为只有想清楚自己真正喜欢什么，才能做出最合适的选择。对我来说，想清楚“真正喜欢什么”是个难题。
column2: Dàxué shēnghuó mǎshàng jiù yào jiéshù le, wǒ zuìjìn jīngcháng bèi wèn dào yí ge wèntí——"nǐ yǐhòu xiǎng zuò shénme", zhège wèntí zhēn bù róngyì huídá. Wǒ yě wèn le jǐ ge tóngxué, dàjiā xuǎnzé de fāngxiàng dōu bùtóng. Yǒude xiǎng jìxù zài xuéxiào xuéxí, yǒude dǎsuàn chū guó liúxué, hái yǒude juédìng xiān zhǎo gōngzuò. Wǒ rènwéi zhǐyǒu xiǎng qīngchu zìjǐ zhēnzhèng xǐhuan shénme, cái néng zuò chū zuì héshì de xuǎnzé. Duì wǒ lái shuō, xiǎng qīngchu "zhēnzhèng xǐhuan shénme" shì ge nántí.
column3: College life is about to end, and lately I've often been asked one question—"What do you want to do in the future?"—and it's really not easy to answer. I asked several classmates, and everyone's chosen direction is different. Some want to keep studying at school, some plan to study abroad, and others decide to find a job first. I believe only by figuring out what you truly love can you make the most suitable choice. For me, figuring out "what I truly love" is a tough problem.

column1: 我要在中国过年，真开心。
column2: Wǒ yào zài Zhōngguó guònián, zhēn kāixīn.
column3: I get to celebrate the New Year in China—I'm so happy.

column2: Dì-yī cì qǐng wàiguó péngyou lái jiā li guò Chūnjié, wǒ yě hěn gāoxìng.
column3: It's the first time inviting a foreign friend home for Spring Festival—I'm happy too.

column1: 你们怎样过节？
column2: Nǐmen zěnyàng guò jié?
column3: How do you celebrate the festival?

column1: 春节是中国最重要的节日，我们一般会回家，跟家人一起过。
column2: Chūnjié shì Zhōngguó zuì zhòngyào de jiérì, wǒmen yìbān huì huí jiā, gēn jiārén yìqǐ guò.
column3: Spring Festival is China's most important holiday—we usually go home and spend it with family.

column1: 那你跟家人会一起做什么？
column2: Nà nǐ gēn jiārén huì yìqǐ zuò shénme?
column3: So what do you and your family do together?

column1: 我们家会一边包饺子，一边看春节联欢晚会，一直到十二点以后才睡觉。
column2: Wǒmen jiā huì yìbiān bāo jiǎozi, yìbiān kàn Chūnjié Liánhuān Wǎnhuì, yìzhí dào shí'èr diǎn yǐhòu cái shuìjiào.
column3: Our family makes dumplings while watching the Spring Festival Gala, staying up past twelve before going to bed.

column1: 听起来很有意思。春节放几天假？
column2: Tīng qǐlai hěn yǒu yìsi. Chūnjié fàng jǐ tiān jià?
column3: That sounds fun. How many days off is Spring Festival?

column1: 大概七八天。
column2: Dàgài qī-bā tiān.
column3: About seven or eight days.

column3: Auntie Zhang, Uncle Li—happy New Year! This is a gift I prepared; please accept it.

column3: There are drinks and mineral water on the table—help yourself to whatever you want.

column3: Sit and watch some TV first—the dumplings will be wrapped soon.

column3: That was three or four years ago, right?

column2: Shì a, shíjiān guò de zhēn kuài, hǎoxiàng shì bùjiǔ qián fāshēng de yíyàng.
column3: Yeah, time flies—it feels like it happened not long ago.

column3: When he first left home, I found it hard to get used to—if I went a few days without a video call with him, I'd miss him a lot.

column2: Hái yǒu zuìhòu yí ge xuéqī jiù yào bìyè le, tā hěn kuài jiù huì huílai le.
column3: Just one last semester and he'll graduate—he'll be back soon.

column1: 这次来中国，我最高兴的是认识了李文的父母。他们给我看了李文出生时的照片，还给我讲了很多他过去的故事。李文高中时很想学医，从那时起就努力学习。高三的时候，因为成绩特别好，他得到了出国留学的机会。在他身上，我懂得了，只要一直坚持，就能完成自己的目标。我相信，他以后一定会发展得更好。
column2: Zhè cì lái Zhōngguó, wǒ zuì gāoxìng de shì rènshi le Lǐ Wén de fùmǔ. Tāmen gěi wǒ kàn le Lǐ Wén chūshēng shí de zhàopiàn, hái gěi wǒ jiǎng le hěn duō tā guòqù de gùshi. Lǐ Wén gāozhōng shí hěn xiǎng xué yī, cóng nà shí qǐ jiù nǔlì xuéxí. Gāosān de shíhou, yīnwèi chéngjì tèbié hǎo, tā dédào le chū guó liúxué de jīhuì. Zài tā shēnshang, wǒ dǒngdé le, zhǐyào yìzhí jiānchí, jiù néng wánchéng zìjǐ de mùbiāo. Wǒ xiāngxìn, tā yǐhòu yídìng huì fāzhǎn de gèng hǎo.
column3: On this trip to China, what made me happiest was meeting Li Wen's parents. They showed me photos of Li Wen when he was born and told me many stories from his past. In high school Li Wen really wanted to study medicine, and from then on he studied hard. In his senior year, because his grades were excellent, he got the chance to study abroad. From him, I've come to understand that as long as you keep persevering, you can reach your goals. I believe he'll surely do even better in the future.
